A buyer sends one product link through the quote form at https://importfromchina.shop/#quote, receives one delivered price on WhatsApp in Pakistani rupees within 24 hours (item, shipping, customs and our fee, with the fee stated upfront), pays once before the item ships, and receives it at any address in Pakistan in 7 to 15 days after the seller dispatches. One item per order. No bulk, wholesale or resale stock. Shipping from China usually costs Rs 5,000 to 20,000 depending on the item's size and type, plus the service fee, so the service makes sense for items worth around Rs 10,000 or more.

## How to Import From China to Pakistan: Two Routes, Step by Step
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-import-from-china-to-pakistan
Category: Guide
Updated: October 23, 2026

There are two ways to import from China to Pakistan. For commercial quantities in your own name you need an NTN, usually sales tax registration and a Pakistan Single Window subscription, then you pay the supplier through your bank, ship by air or sea and file a goods declaration. For a single item, a courier, a marketplace that ships here, or a single-item service clears it for you on your CNIC. Either way most goods attract duty and taxes, so work out the landed cost before you pay.

Q: Can an individual import from China to Pakistan without a company?
A: Yes. Single items come through a courier, post or an import service on your CNIC. To import commercially in your own name you need an NTN, usually sales tax registration and a PSW subscription, but not a company.
Q: Is there a duty-free limit for imports from China?
A: Only a small one. Section 19C of the Customs Act, as amended by the Finance Act 2025, waives duties and taxes where goods through post or courier are worth no more than one thousand rupees.
Q: How long does it take to import from China to Pakistan?
A: Air freight typically takes 7 to 15 days door to door including customs, and sea takes about 25 to 45 days for a shared container. Add the supplier's preparation time.
Q: Do I need Pakistan Single Window to import from China?
A: Only if you import commercially in your own name. For a single parcel, the courier or service that clears it uses its own registration.
Q: What is the minimum order to import from China?
A: There is no legal minimum. Suppliers set their own minimum order quantities, and some list single pieces. Our service handles exactly one item per order and no bulk.
Q: Can I pay a Chinese seller with JazzCash or Easypaisa?
A: Not directly. Chinese platforms do not accept JazzCash, Easypaisa or Raast. You can use them to pay a local agent or service, which then pays the seller.

## Customs Duty on Imports from China to Pakistan: How It Is Calculated
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/customs-duty-china-to-pakistan
Category: Customs
Updated: October 23, 2026

Pakistan charges four main taxes on imports from China: customs duty (0%, 5%, 10%, 15% or 20% depending on the HS code, higher on a few goods), additional customs duty (0% on most lower-duty goods, up to 6% on a few), sales tax (18%), and advance income tax (5.5% on most finished goods for filers, double for non-filers), plus regulatory duty on some goods. They are calculated in sequence on the customs value, so the combined bill is commonly 25–60% of the declared value. The exact rate depends on the product's HS code in the Pakistan Customs Tariff.

Q: How much is customs duty from China to Pakistan?
A: It depends on the product's HS code. Customs duty ranges from 0% to 20% or more, and with additional duty, 18% sales tax and advance income tax the combined charge is commonly 25% to 60% of the shipment's customs value.
Q: Is there a duty-free limit for imports from China to Pakistan?
A: There is no meaningful duty-free allowance for commercial goods. Small parcels are also assessed. Limited exemptions exist for genuine personal gifts and baggage, but they do not apply to items for resale.
Q: Does the China–Pakistan Free Trade Agreement reduce duty?
A: Yes, for goods on the CPFTA schedule that ship with a valid Certificate of Origin from China. Customs duty is reduced or removed. Sales tax and advance income tax still apply.
Q: Who pays the customs duty, the buyer or the supplier?
A: The buyer in Pakistan, unless the shipment is sold on DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) terms. Door-to-door sourcing services typically quote DDP so duty is included in the price you pay.
Q: What is WeBOC?
A: WeBOC (Web Based One Customs) is Pakistan Customs' online clearance system. Goods Declarations, assessments and duty payments are filed through it, usually by a licensed clearing agent. It is being integrated into the Pakistan Single Window.

## Shipping from China to Pakistan: Air vs Sea, Cost and Delivery Time
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/shipping-from-china-to-pakistan-cost-time
Category: Shipping
Updated: October 3, 2026

Shipping from China to Pakistan takes 5–10 days by air express, 7–15 days by air freight, and 25–45 days by sea. Air is priced per kilogram and suits shipments under about 500 kg. Sea is priced per cubic metre (LCL) or per container (FCL) and is far cheaper for heavy or bulky goods. The right choice depends on your product's weight-to-value ratio and how fast you need stock.

Q: How many days does it take to ship from China to Pakistan?
A: 5 to 10 days by air express, 7 to 15 days by air freight including customs, and 25 to 45 days by sea. Supplier production time is extra.
Q: How much does it cost to ship 1 kg from China to Pakistan?
A: Air rates are quoted per kg and fall sharply with volume. Small parcels pay the highest per-kg rate, while consolidated shipments of 100 kg or more pay a fraction of that. Ask for a quote based on your actual weight and dimensions, since volumetric weight often applies.
Q: What is the cheapest way to ship from China to Pakistan?
A: Sea freight is the cheapest per kilogram. For small orders under about 100 kg, air consolidation through a forwarder is usually cheaper overall because sea shipments carry fixed port and documentation fees.
Q: Can I ship directly from a Chinese supplier to my home in Lahore or Islamabad?
A: Yes. A door-to-door service collects from the supplier in China, ships, clears customs and delivers to any address in Pakistan. You do not need to go to the port or airport.
Q: Which port in Pakistan receives shipments from China?
A: Sea cargo arrives at Karachi Port (KPT) or Port Qasim. Air cargo arrives at Jinnah International (Karachi), Allama Iqbal International (Lahore) or Islamabad International.

## Alibaba vs 1688: Which Is Better for Pakistani Buyers?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/alibaba-vs-1688-pakistan
Category: Sourcing
Updated: October 3, 2026

Alibaba is built for international buyers: English interface, card payments, Trade Assurance protection, and suppliers who export. 1688 is Alibaba's domestic Chinese platform: prices are typically 20–40% lower and MOQs smaller, but it is in Chinese, accepts only Chinese payment methods, and ships only within China. Pakistani buyers use Alibaba for direct orders and 1688 through a sourcing agent who handles payment and export.

Q: Is 1688 cheaper than Alibaba?
A: Yes, usually by 20 to 40 percent for the same product, because 1688 prices are for the Chinese domestic market and many Alibaba sellers are trading companies that source from 1688.
Q: Does 1688 ship to Pakistan?
A: No. 1688 sellers ship only to addresses in China. Pakistani buyers use a sourcing agent with a Chinese warehouse who receives, consolidates and exports the goods.
Q: Can I pay 1688 with a Pakistani card?
A: No. 1688 accepts Alipay and Chinese bank payments only. An agent pays the seller on your behalf and you pay the agent in PKR.
Q: Is Alibaba safe for buyers in Pakistan?
A: Alibaba is safe when you pay through Trade Assurance, verify the supplier, and start with a small order. Paying outside the platform or to a personal account removes your protection.
Q: What is Alibaba's minimum order quantity?
A: Each supplier sets their own MOQ. It is commonly 100 to 1,000 units for factories, though many suppliers accept smaller trial orders at a higher unit price.

## Best Products to Import from China to Pakistan for Resale (2026)
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/best-products-to-import-from-china-to-pakistan
Category: Products
Updated: October 3, 2026

The best products to import from China to Pakistan are light, high-margin items with steady local demand: phone accessories and earbuds, beauty and skincare tools, kitchen gadgets, home organisers, fashion accessories, LED lighting, and toys. They ship cheaply by air, carry moderate duty, and sell through Daraz, Instagram, WhatsApp and local shops. Avoid heavy, low-value, battery-restricted or heavily regulated goods for your first orders.

Q: What is the most profitable product to import from China to Pakistan?
A: There is no single answer, but phone accessories, wireless earbuds, beauty tools and kitchen gadgets consistently give good margins because they are light, in demand, and sell at two to three times landed cost.
Q: How much money do I need to start importing from China?
A: A test order of a light product can start from roughly PKR 50,000 to 150,000 including shipping and duty. Larger first orders are not necessary and increase risk before you know the product sells.
Q: Can I import branded products like Apple or Samsung accessories from China?
A: Not legally unless they are genuine and you are an authorised distributor. Counterfeit branded goods are seized at customs. Unbranded or your own-brand products are the safe route.
Q: Is it better to import one product or many?
A: Start with one or two. Learn the process, the real landed cost and the selling cycle, then add products. Spreading a small budget across ten products makes every one of them unprofitable.
Q: Can I sell imported products on Daraz?
A: Yes. Daraz allows unbranded and own-brand products. You need a seller account, product listings and stock in Pakistan, which a door-to-door import service delivers to you.

## How to Find Reliable Chinese Suppliers and Avoid Scams
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-find-reliable-chinese-suppliers
Category: Sourcing
Updated: October 3, 2026

To find a reliable Chinese supplier, verify the business licence, confirm whether they are a factory or trading company, check years on the platform and transaction history, order a sample before bulk, pay through Trade Assurance or a 30/70 split, and get a pre-shipment inspection with photos or video. Never pay 100% upfront to a personal account, and treat prices far below the market as a warning sign.

Q: How do I know if a Chinese supplier is legitimate?
A: Check the business licence, confirm the company name matches the bank account, look at years and transaction volume on the platform, ask for a factory video, and order a sample. Suppliers that refuse any of these are not worth the risk.
Q: Is it safe to pay a Chinese supplier by bank transfer?
A: Only for verified suppliers you have ordered from before, and only to the company's registered account. For first orders use Alibaba Trade Assurance or pay through a sourcing agent.
Q: What is a gold supplier on Alibaba?
A: A paid membership tier, not a quality guarantee. It shows the supplier has invested in the platform and passed basic verification. Still run the full checks.
Q: Can I visit the factory in China?
A: Yes, with a business visa. Most Pakistani buyers do not, and instead rely on video calls, third-party inspections, or a sourcing agent who visits on their behalf.
Q: What should I do if a supplier sends the wrong goods?
A: If you paid through Trade Assurance, open a dispute with evidence. If you used an agent, the agent handles the return before shipping. If you paid directly by transfer, recovery is difficult, which is why payment method matters.

## What Does a China Sourcing Agent Do? And Do You Need One in Pakistan?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/china-sourcing-agent-pakistan
Category: Sourcing
Updated: October 3, 2026

A China sourcing agent finds and verifies suppliers, negotiates prices, places and pays for orders (including on 1688, which foreigners cannot use directly), inspects goods at a warehouse in China, consolidates multiple orders into one shipment, and arranges shipping and customs clearance to your door in Pakistan. Agents charge a service fee, typically a percentage of the order value or a flat fee per shipment. For a single item or a small order, an agent usually saves more than it costs.

Q: What is the difference between a sourcing agent and a freight forwarder?
A: A freight forwarder only moves goods you have already bought. A sourcing agent finds the supplier, buys, inspects and consolidates, then arranges the freight. Many agents, including us, do both.
Q: How much does a China sourcing agent cost in Pakistan?
A: Commonly 5 to 10 percent of order value, a flat fee per shipment, or an all-in landed price per unit. Always get the full breakdown of product, fee, freight, duty and delivery.
Q: Can a sourcing agent buy from 1688 for me?
A: Yes. This is one of the main reasons to use one. The agent registers, pays in RMB, and receives the goods at a Chinese warehouse before exporting to Pakistan.
Q: Do I need an NTN to import through a sourcing agent?
A: No. A door-to-door agent clears customs under their own registration and delivers duty-paid. You only need a CNIC and a delivery address.
Q: Is using a sourcing agent safe?
A: It is safer than paying unknown Chinese suppliers directly, provided the agent is transparent about pricing, has a real warehouse, and has local support you can reach. Start with a small order to test them.

## How to Buy From AliExpress in Pakistan (And Why Orders Fail)
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-buy-from-aliexpress-in-pakistan
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 23, 2026

AliExpress does deliver to Pakistan for most listings, but buyers hit four problems: Pakistani cards get declined at checkout, delivery takes 25 to 45 days, parcels get held at customs for duty, and there are no local returns. If you only want one item, a Pakistan-based sourcing service that buys it for you and delivers duty-paid in 7 to 15 days is usually faster and less stressful.

Q: Is AliExpress available in Pakistan?
A: Yes, AliExpress accepts Pakistani accounts and addresses, and most sellers ship to Pakistan. Payment and delivery time are the usual problems, not availability.
Q: Which Pakistani cards work on AliExpress?
A: Visa and Mastercard debit or credit cards with international transactions enabled. PayPak cards do not work. Enable international use through your bank's app before ordering.
Q: How much is customs duty on AliExpress parcels in Pakistan?
A: It depends on the item. Duty, sales tax and advance income tax together commonly add 25 to 60 percent of the item value. You find out the exact figure only when the parcel is assessed.
Q: Can I track an AliExpress parcel in Pakistan?
A: Partly. Tracking works until the parcel leaves China and often resumes once Pakistan Post scans it. The gap in between can be weeks.
Q: Is it cheaper to use AliExpress directly or a sourcing service?
A: For a very cheap item that clears customs unnoticed, AliExpress direct can be cheaper. For anything worth more than a few thousand rupees, a service that delivers duty-paid in 7 to 15 days usually costs about the same once you add duty and saves weeks and the payment hassle.

## How to Buy From Taobao in Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-buy-from-taobao-in-pakistan
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 3, 2026

Taobao sellers ship only within China, the site is in Chinese, and it accepts only Chinese payment methods, so you cannot buy from it directly from Pakistan. Pakistani buyers use a sourcing agent with a Chinese address: the agent buys the item, receives it in China, then exports it to you. For a single item, that means sending the Taobao link to a service that delivers it to your door for one price.

Q: Does Taobao deliver to Pakistan?
A: No. Taobao sellers ship within China only. Pakistani buyers use a sourcing agent with a Chinese address who receives the item and forwards it to Pakistan.
Q: Is Taobao cheaper than AliExpress?
A: Usually yes, often by a third or more for the same item, because Taobao prices are for the Chinese domestic market. Agent fees and shipping narrow the gap but rarely close it.
Q: Can I pay Taobao with a Pakistani card?
A: No. Taobao accepts Alipay and Chinese bank cards only. An agent pays on your behalf and you pay the agent in rupees.
Q: Is Taobao the same as Alibaba?
A: They are owned by the same group but serve different buyers. Alibaba.com is for international wholesale. Taobao is for Chinese consumers buying single pieces.
Q: How long does a Taobao order take to reach Pakistan?
A: The seller usually ships to the agent within 1 to 3 days. From there, 7 to 15 days by air to your door including customs. Allow 2 to 3 weeks in total.

## Does Temu Deliver to Pakistan? What Works in 2026
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/does-temu-deliver-to-pakistan
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 21, 2026

Yes. At the time of writing (October 2026), Temu delivers to Pakistan through its own Pakistan site and app, with prices in rupees. Temu's Pakistan shipping page lists free standard shipping on all orders, typically 5 to 13 business days after a 1 to 3 day processing time. The site shows JazzCash, Easypaisa and card logos for payment. If the app shows another country, change the region in settings rather than using a VPN, and buy only through the official app or temu.com.

Q: Can Temu deliver in Pakistan?
A: Yes. At the time of writing (October 2026), Temu runs a Pakistan site and app with prices in rupees and delivers to most addresses in Pakistan. Some individual listings may not ship to Pakistan.
Q: Is Temu delivery to Pakistan free?
A: Temu's Pakistan shipping page lists free standard shipping on all orders, with delivery in 5 to 13 business days after 1 to 3 days of processing. Customs duty is a separate matter.
Q: Do Temu deliver in Pakistan with cash on delivery?
A: Cash on delivery was not among the payment logos on Temu's Pakistan site when we checked. The site showed JazzCash, Easypaisa, major cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
Q: Will I pay customs duty on a Temu order in Pakistan?
A: Parcels worth up to Rs 1,000 sent by post or courier should not attract duty under section 19C of the Customs Act. Above that, duty can apply, and Temu's terms say you pay any amount customs assesses beyond what was collected at checkout.
Q: Does Shein deliver to Pakistan too?
A: Yes. When we checked from Pakistan in October 2026, Shein's shipping page listed standard shipping of 7 to 11 business days and had Pakistan-specific delivery terms. Confirm the estimate at checkout for your own address.
Q: Is a WhatsApp seller called Temu Pakistan official?
A: Treat it as a reseller, not Temu. Buy through the Temu app or temu.com with the region set to Pakistan, and never pay a personal wallet or bank account for a Temu order.

## Can You Buy Just One Item on Alibaba From Pakistan?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/buy-one-item-from-alibaba-pakistan
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 3, 2026

Yes, you can buy one piece on Alibaba from Pakistan, but only from listings with a minimum order of 1, and shipping for a single item is expensive because Alibaba suppliers quote courier rates. It works for higher-value items such as equipment, tools or specialist electronics. For cheap or small items, a single-item sourcing service that uses consolidated air freight is usually cheaper and simpler.

Q: Can I order 1 piece from Alibaba?
A: Yes, from listings with a minimum order of 1 piece. Use the Ready to Ship filter and check the price table shows a 1-piece price.
Q: Does Alibaba ship to Pakistan?
A: Yes. Suppliers ship single pieces by express courier such as DHL or FedEx. Shipping is quoted at checkout and is expensive for small orders.
Q: How much is shipping for one item from Alibaba to Pakistan?
A: Courier rates for 1 kg are commonly several thousand rupees and rise with weight. For light items, shipping can exceed the item's price.
Q: Do I pay customs on a single Alibaba item?
A: Yes. The courier clears customs and charges you duty, sales tax and advance income tax plus a handling fee before delivery.
Q: Can a Pakistani individual buy on Alibaba without a company?
A: Yes. Alibaba accounts can be personal. Trade Assurance works for individuals. You only need a company if you import commercially in your own name through customs.

## How to Pay Chinese Sellers From Pakistan When Your Card Is Declined
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-pay-chinese-sellers-from-pakistan
Category: Payments
Updated: October 3, 2026

Pakistani buyers cannot use PayPal, and most local debit cards are declined on Chinese platforms unless international transactions are enabled. Options that work: a Visa or Mastercard with international use switched on (for Alibaba and AliExpress), a bank TT for large orders, or paying a Pakistan-based sourcing agent in rupees who pays the Chinese seller for you. For one item, the agent route is the only way to buy from 1688 or Taobao at all.

Q: Can I use PayPal in Pakistan to pay Chinese sellers?
A: No. PayPal does not operate in Pakistan. Use a Visa or Mastercard with international transactions enabled, or pay through a sourcing agent in rupees.
Q: Why is my card declined on AliExpress or Alibaba?
A: Usually because international transactions are disabled on the card, or the card is PayPak. Enable international use in your bank app and retry.
Q: Can I pay Chinese sellers with JazzCash or Easypaisa?
A: Not directly. Chinese platforms do not accept Pakistani wallets. You can pay a Pakistan-based sourcing agent with them, and the agent pays the seller.
Q: How do I pay for a Taobao or 1688 item from Pakistan?
A: Through an agent. These sites accept only Chinese payment methods. The agent buys the item and you pay the agent in rupees.
Q: Is it safe to pay a sourcing agent before the item ships?
A: It is normal practice, and safer than paying an unknown Chinese seller, provided the agent is transparent about the full price, has a business identity, and you can reach them on WhatsApp.

## Cheapest Way to Get One Item From China to Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/cheapest-way-to-get-one-item-from-china-to-pakistan
Category: Cost
Updated: October 23, 2026

For one item, the cheapest route depends on value and weight. Very cheap, light items are cheapest on AliExpress direct if you can wait 25 to 45 days and your card works. For anything worth more than a few thousand rupees, a single-item sourcing service that uses consolidated air freight and includes customs in one price is usually cheaper than Alibaba courier shipping and far more predictable than AliExpress, with delivery in 7 to 15 days.

Q: What is the cheapest way to ship one item from China to Pakistan?
A: For very cheap, light items, ordinary post via AliExpress. For anything else, consolidated air freight through a single-item service is cheaper than courier and includes customs in one price.
Q: Is it cheaper to import one item or buy it on Daraz?
A: Often cheaper to import if the item is not common on Daraz or carries a big markup there. For everyday items that Daraz stocks, Daraz is usually cheaper and faster. See our Daraz comparison guide.
Q: How much does a sourcing service charge for one item?
A: A fee on top of the item, shipping and duty, stated upfront as part of one price. There is no separate shipping or customs bill.
Q: Can I avoid customs duty on a single item?
A: Not legally. Small post parcels sometimes pass unassessed, but that is luck, not a rule. A duty-paid service removes the uncertainty.
Q: How long does the cheapest option take?
A: Post via AliExpress takes 25 to 45 days. Air freight through a service takes 7 to 15 days door to door.

## What You Cannot Import From China to Pakistan (Restricted Items)
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/what-you-cannot-import-from-china-to-pakistan
Category: Customs
Updated: October 3, 2026

Pakistan bans or restricts several categories that Pakistani buyers often try to order from China: counterfeit branded goods, weapons and weapon parts, drones without permission, medicines and supplements without DRAP approval, mobile phones that need PTA registration and tax, and items that air carriers refuse such as loose lithium batteries, aerosols and some liquids. Everything else, from gadgets to tools to clothing, is generally fine. Check before you pay, because a seized parcel is money gone.

Q: Can I import a drone from China to Pakistan?
A: Not without prior permission. Drones are routinely held or confiscated by Pakistan Customs. Secure the permission first or do not order one.
Q: Is PTA tax charged on a phone imported from China?
A: Yes. Any phone used on Pakistani networks must be registered with PTA and the tax paid after a short grace period. The amount depends on the model and can be substantial.
Q: Can I import medicines or supplements from China for personal use?
A: It is risky. Pharmaceutical items need DRAP approval and personal parcels are often held or destroyed. Avoid unless you have confirmed the rule for the specific product.
Q: Can power banks be shipped from China to Pakistan?
A: By air, usually not through standard routes because of lithium battery rules. Special battery lines or sea freight are needed, which are slower. Devices with built-in batteries, such as earbuds, ship normally.
Q: Will customs seize fake branded goods?
A: Yes. Counterfeit goods are prohibited and are seized without compensation. Buy unbranded items or genuine goods from authorised sellers.

## Daraz vs Importing Directly From China: Which Is Cheaper?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/daraz-vs-importing-from-china
Category: Cost
Updated: October 23, 2026

Daraz is usually the better choice for common, cheap items because delivery takes days and returns are possible. Importing directly from China wins when the item is not on Daraz, when the Daraz price carries a large markup, or when you need a specific model, variant or quality that local sellers do not stock. For a single item, a sourcing service gives you China prices with one rupee total and 7 to 15 day delivery, without the hassle of ordering from China yourself.

Q: Is Daraz cheaper than importing from China?
A: For common, cheap items, usually yes, once you add shipping and duty to the China price. For niche, specialist or higher-value items, importing is often 30 percent or more cheaper.
Q: Does Daraz sell Chinese products?
A: Most of the electronics, accessories, beauty tools and home goods on Daraz are sourced from Chinese suppliers and resold with a markup.
Q: Can I return an item imported from China?
A: Not in the way you can on Daraz. There is no cheap return route to China. A sourcing service can take up a wrong or faulty item with the seller for you.
Q: How long does Daraz take compared to importing?
A: Daraz delivers in 2 to 7 days. Importing takes 7 to 15 days through a service or 25 to 45 days through AliExpress post.
Q: Should I import to sell on Daraz?
A: That is a bulk business and needs commercial import. We only handle single items for personal use, not resale stock.

## How to Buy From 1688 in Pakistan (One Item, Without a Chinese Account)
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-buy-from-1688-in-pakistan
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 3, 2026

1688.com is Alibaba's wholesale site for the Chinese domestic market. It is in Chinese, takes only Chinese payment methods, and sellers ship only within China, so you cannot order from Pakistan directly. Pakistani buyers use an agent who has a Chinese account and address, buys the item, receives it in China and forwards it by air. Many 1688 listings sell single pieces, and prices are typically 20 to 40 percent below Alibaba.com.

Q: Does 1688 ship to Pakistan?
A: No. 1688 sellers ship only to addresses in China. A Pakistani buyer needs an agent with a Chinese address who receives the item and forwards it.
Q: Is 1688 cheaper than Alibaba?
A: Usually. The same supplier's price on 1688 is typically 20 to 40 percent lower than on Alibaba.com, because 1688 is a domestic Chinese price without an export margin.
Q: Can I buy just one piece on 1688?
A: Often, yes. Many listings show 1件起批, meaning from one piece. Others need 2, 3 or more. Factory listings for made-to-order goods have real MOQs that cannot be waived.
Q: Can I pay 1688 with a Pakistani card?
A: No. 1688 accepts Alipay and Chinese bank cards only. An agent pays with Alipay and you pay the agent in rupees.
Q: How long does a 1688 order take to reach Pakistan?
A: The seller usually ships to the agent within 1 to 3 days. Air freight to your door, including customs, then takes about 7 to 15 days. Allow 2 to 3 weeks in total.

## Alibaba vs AliExpress for Pakistani Buyers: Which for One Item?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/alibaba-vs-aliexpress-for-pakistani-buyers
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 23, 2026

Alibaba.com is a wholesale marketplace where suppliers quote by quantity and ship single pieces by expensive courier. AliExpress is a retail marketplace that sells one piece at a fixed price and ships to Pakistan by slow post. For one cheap, light item, AliExpress is simpler if your card works. For a higher-value item, Alibaba with Trade Assurance gives stronger protection. Both leave you to pay customs duty on arrival.

Q: Is AliExpress cheaper than Alibaba for one item?
A: On the item price, Alibaba is usually lower. On the total, AliExpress often wins for light items because Alibaba suppliers ship single pieces by courier at high rates.
Q: Does Alibaba sell to individuals in Pakistan?
A: Yes. You can open a personal account, buy from MOQ 1 listings and pay through Trade Assurance. You do not need a company unless you clear customs commercially in your own name.
Q: Which is faster to Pakistan, Alibaba or AliExpress?
A: Alibaba, because suppliers ship by courier in 5 to 10 days. AliExpress post takes 25 to 45 days.
Q: Do I pay customs duty on Alibaba and AliExpress orders?
A: Usually yes on Alibaba, because the courier clears customs and bills you. On AliExpress, duty is charged if the parcel is stopped and assessed, which is common for electronics and anything of value.
Q: Can I use Trade Assurance on AliExpress?
A: No. Trade Assurance is an Alibaba.com feature. AliExpress has its own Buyer Protection with a refund if the item does not arrive or does not match the listing.

## Alibaba Trade Assurance Explained for Pakistani Buyers
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/alibaba-trade-assurance-explained-pakistan
Category: Payments
Updated: October 3, 2026

Trade Assurance is Alibaba.com's built-in payment protection. You pay Alibaba, not the supplier, and the money is released to the supplier only after you confirm the goods arrived as agreed or the dispute window closes. From Pakistan you can pay with a Visa or Mastercard that has international transactions enabled, or by bank transfer. It covers late shipment and goods that differ from the order. It does not cover customs duty, courier charges or returns.

Q: Is Alibaba Trade Assurance available in Pakistan?
A: Yes. Any buyer with an Alibaba.com account can place a Trade Assurance order. Pakistani buyers usually pay with a Visa or Mastercard that has international transactions enabled.
Q: Does Trade Assurance cover customs duty in Pakistan?
A: No. Duty, sales tax and courier clearance fees are the buyer's cost and are not refundable through Alibaba.
Q: How long do I have to open a Trade Assurance dispute?
A: At the time of writing, commonly up to 30 days after delivery for most orders, and before you confirm receipt. Check the window shown on your order page, as terms change.
Q: Can I get a refund without returning the item?
A: Sometimes. Full refunds without return are more likely when the item did not arrive or is clearly different from the order. For quality complaints, partial refunds are more common.
Q: Is paying a supplier directly cheaper than Trade Assurance?
A: The supplier may offer a small discount, but you lose all protection. For a buyer in Pakistan with no way to visit the supplier, that trade is not worth it.

## Pinduoduo in Pakistan: What It Is and How to Get Items From It
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/pinduoduo-in-pakistan
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 3, 2026

Pinduoduo (拼多多) is a Chinese domestic shopping app owned by PDD Holdings, the same company that runs Temu. It is in Chinese only, needs a Chinese phone number and Chinese payment, and sellers ship only within China, so it does not deliver to Pakistan. Pakistani buyers get Pinduoduo items through an agent with a Chinese address, or by finding the same product on 1688 or Taobao, where most Pinduoduo sellers also source.

Q: Is Pinduoduo available in Pakistan?
A: No. Pinduoduo is a Chinese domestic app with Chinese-only registration, payment and delivery. It does not ship to Pakistan or any country outside China.
Q: Is Temu the international version of Pinduoduo?
A: Roughly. Both are run by PDD Holdings and share many sellers, but they are separate apps. Unlike Pinduoduo, Temu does deliver to Pakistan.
Q: Can I pay Pinduoduo with a Pakistani card?
A: No. Pinduoduo accepts WeChat Pay, Alipay and Chinese bank cards only. An agent pays on your behalf and you pay the agent in rupees.
Q: How do I buy from Pinduoduo from Pakistan?
A: Send the product link or a screenshot to an agent. The agent buys it in China, or finds the same item on 1688 or Taobao, and forwards it to you by air with customs cleared.
Q: Why is Pinduoduo cheaper than Temu?
A: Pinduoduo prices are domestic Chinese prices with group-buy discounts and no international shipping built in. Temu prices include cross-border logistics and local operations.

## How to Search Taobao and 1688 by Image and Find It Cheaper
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-search-taobao-and-1688-by-image
Category: Sourcing
Updated: October 3, 2026

Both the Taobao app and the 1688 app have a camera icon in the search bar that searches by photo. Take a screenshot of the item from AliExpress, Daraz, Instagram or a video, crop to the product, and upload it. Results show visually similar listings sorted by sales or price. If the camera search fails, translate the product name into Chinese with Google Translate and search by text. The same item is often far cheaper on 1688 than on AliExpress.

Q: Can I use Taobao image search without an account?
A: Browsing and image search commonly work without logging in, though the app sometimes prompts for an account. Buying always needs a Chinese account, which is why Pakistani buyers use an agent.
Q: Does 1688 have image search?
A: Yes. Both the 1688 app and 1688.com have a camera icon in the search bar. Upload a product photo and it returns matching wholesale listings.
Q: Why does my English search return nothing on Taobao?
A: Taobao's search index is Chinese. Translate the product name into Simplified Chinese with Google Translate, or use image search instead.
Q: Is the same item really cheaper on 1688 than AliExpress?
A: Usually. 1688 prices are domestic wholesale prices, typically 20 to 40 percent below Alibaba.com and lower still compared with AliExpress for the same factory product.
Q: What if I find the item but cannot read the variants?
A: Send the link and a screenshot of the variant you want to an agent. They confirm the colour, size or model with the seller before quoting a price.

## How to Copy and Share a Product Link From Chinese Shopping Apps
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-copy-and-share-a-product-link-from-chinese-apps
Category: Guide
Updated: October 3, 2026

Every Chinese shopping app has a share button on the product page, usually an arrow or three-dots icon near the top right. Tap it, choose copy link (复制链接) or copy, and paste the result into our quote form. Taobao often produces a 淘口令 (Taobao code), a string of symbols and Chinese characters, which works just as well as a URL. If you cannot find a share option, a clear screenshot of the product page is an acceptable fallback.

Q: What is a 淘口令 or Taobao code?
A: A text token Taobao generates when you share a product. It contains symbols and Chinese characters and opens the product when pasted into the Taobao app. Send it exactly as copied.
Q: Can I send a screenshot instead of a link?
A: Yes, as a fallback. Include the title, price, seller name and the variant you want. A link is faster and more accurate.
Q: Do Temu links work for a quote?
A: Yes. Temu delivers to Pakistan, so if it ships your item you can order there directly. If it does not, we use the Temu link to identify the product, find it from the Chinese supplier and quote one delivered price.
Q: Why is the link required before you give a price?
A: The link tells us the exact seller, variant, price and weight. Without it any price would be a guess.
Q: What else should I send with the link?
A: The exact colour, size or model, your city, and anything unusual such as a battery, liquid or brand name. Quantity is always one.

## What Is a Landed Price? (For One Item From China to Pakistan)
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/what-is-a-landed-price
Category: Cost
Updated: October 23, 2026

A landed price, also called landed cost, is the full amount it costs to get an item from the seller to your door, with nothing left to pay. For one item from China to Pakistan it includes the product price, shipping inside China, international freight, insurance, Pakistan customs duty and taxes, clearance and handling, local delivery and any service fee. A proper quote should be one rupee figure, because any cost left out becomes a surprise bill later.

Q: What is the difference between landed price and landed cost?
A: Nothing meaningful. Both mean the total cost of an item delivered to its final destination with all freight, duties, taxes and fees included.
Q: Does landed price include customs duty?
A: Yes. If a quote excludes duty or says duty is payable on arrival, it is not a landed price.
Q: Is the customs value the same as the item price?
A: No. Pakistan Customs uses the CIF value, which is item plus freight plus insurance, and may apply a valuation ruling that sets a minimum value for that type of goods.
Q: Why do landed prices change between quote and payment?
A: Because sellers price in RMB or USD and the rupee rate moves. A quote should state how long it is valid.
Q: Can I calculate a landed price myself?
A: Yes, if you know the weight, the shipping rate, the HS code and the current duty and tax rates. Most single-item buyers find it easier to ask for one delivered price.

## Incoterms for Single-Item Buyers: EXW, FOB, CIF and DDP in Plain Words
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/incoterms-for-single-item-buyers-exw-fob-ddp
Category: Shipping
Updated: October 3, 2026

Incoterms are three-letter trade terms that say which costs and risks are the seller's and which are yours. EXW means you collect from the factory door. FOB means the seller gets the goods onto the ship at a Chinese port. CIF means the seller pays freight and insurance to Karachi, and you handle customs. DDP means the seller delivers to your address with duties paid. For a single item, DDP is the only term that gives you one total cost.

Q: What does DDP mean when buying from China?
A: Delivered Duty Paid. The seller or service delivers to your address in Pakistan with customs cleared and duties and taxes already paid. You owe nothing on delivery.
Q: What is the difference between FOB and CIF?
A: Under FOB the seller gets the goods on board a ship in China and you pay ocean freight and insurance. Under CIF the seller also pays freight and insurance to Karachi. In both, you handle Pakistan customs and duty.
Q: Why does Pakistan Customs use the CIF value?
A: Pakistan assesses duty on the value of the goods including freight and insurance to the border. This applies whatever Incoterm you bought on.
Q: Is an EXW price a good deal?
A: It is the lowest number but includes the least. You must arrange collection in China, export, freight, customs and delivery. For one item it is not practical without an agent.
Q: Can an individual in Pakistan buy on FOB terms?
A: Technically, but it means hiring a forwarder and a clearing agent and paying port fees sized for commercial cargo. For a single item it costs far more than it saves.

## China to Pakistan Import Glossary: 30 Terms Explained in Plain English
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-glossary-china-to-pakistan
Category: Guide
Updated: October 23, 2026

Buying from China to Pakistan comes with vocabulary from three worlds: the Chinese platforms (Tmall, 1688, Trade Assurance, Taobao code), shipping (CIF, DDP, LCL, volumetric weight) and Pakistan Customs (HS/PCT code, WeBOC, PSW, valuation ruling, CPFTA). This glossary defines thirty of them in one or two plain sentences each, with a table for quick lookup and short notes on the ones that trip up single-item buyers most.

Q: What is the difference between an HS code and a PCT code?
A: The HS code is the international six-digit classification. Pakistan extends it to an eight-digit PCT code in its customs tariff, and the PCT code sets the duty rate.
Q: What does MOQ 1 mean?
A: The seller will sell a single piece. On 1688 it appears as 1件起批. A higher MOQ means you must buy at least that many.
Q: What is volumetric weight and why am I charged for it?
A: Length times width times height in centimetres divided by 6000 gives the volumetric weight for air. Carriers bill the higher of actual and volumetric weight because space costs as much as mass.
Q: Do I need WeBOC registration to receive one parcel from China?
A: No. WeBOC and PSW registration are for commercial importers. An individual's parcel is cleared by the courier or agent against a CNIC.
Q: Does CPFTA make my item duty free?
A: Only for listed goods with a valid Certificate of Origin from China, and only for customs duty. Sales tax and advance income tax still apply.

## Is It Safe to Order From China to Pakistan? Risks and Fixes
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/is-it-safe-to-order-from-china-to-pakistan
Category: Guide
Updated: October 23, 2026

Ordering from China to Pakistan is generally safe when you buy from rated sellers on the big platforms, avoid branded replicas and restricted goods, pay through a protected channel, and expect customs duty. The risks that actually hurt people are paying a seller outside the platform, ordering counterfeits or restricted items that customs seizes, and getting a surprise duty bill. A single-item service removes the payment and customs uncertainty but cannot make a bad listing good.

Q: Is it safe to buy from Alibaba in Pakistan?
A: Yes, when you pay through Trade Assurance and buy from suppliers with a long history. The main risks are courier shipping cost and the duty bill on arrival, not fraud.
Q: Can I get scammed on AliExpress?
A: Rarely in the sense of losing money, because non-delivery is refunded. The common problem is receiving a lower-quality item than the photos suggest, which is hard to return from Pakistan.
Q: Will Pakistan Customs open my parcel?
A: Parcels are scanned and may be opened for assessment. Ordinary goods are assessed for duty, not seized. Counterfeits and restricted items are seized.
Q: Is it safe to pay a sourcing service before the item ships?
A: It is normal practice. Check the service has a business identity, a verifiable account name, a stated fee and one total price, and keep the WhatsApp record.
Q: What is the safest way to order one item from China to Pakistan?
A: Choose a rated seller, avoid branded replicas and restricted goods, and buy on delivered duty paid terms so the price you agree is the price you pay. A single-item service does this for you.

## Import Timeline From China to Pakistan: What Happens Day by Day
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-timeline-china-to-pakistan-day-by-day
Category: Shipping
Updated: October 3, 2026

For one item by air freight: you pay, the order goes to the seller, the seller dispatches in 1 to 3 days to a warehouse in China, the parcel is consolidated and flies within a few days, Pakistan customs takes 1 to 4 working days, and local delivery adds 1 to 3 days. Door to door, 7 to 15 days after dispatch is typical. Most delays come from the seller, not the flight.

Q: How long does it take to import one item from China to Pakistan by air?
A: Typically 7 to 15 days door to door after the seller dispatches, including customs. Add 1 to 3 days for the seller to dispatch an in-stock item.
Q: Which stage of the import takes the longest?
A: Usually seller dispatch when the item is not in stock, followed by customs when the item needs a valuation check. The flight itself is rarely the issue.
Q: Does the timeline include customs clearance?
A: Yes. The 7 to 15 day estimate covers arrival, declaration, assessment, duty payment and release at the Pakistani airport.
Q: Why has my parcel been in China for over a week?
A: Either the seller has not dispatched, the parcel is waiting for the next consolidated shipment, or it is a slow period such as Chinese New Year or after 11.11. Check with whoever placed the order.
Q: Is delivery slower outside Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad?
A: A little. Major cities are usually delivered within 1 to 2 days of customs release. Smaller towns add a day or two, remote areas more.

## Air Freight vs Courier From China to Pakistan for One Item
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/air-freight-vs-courier-china-to-pakistan-one-item
Category: Shipping
Updated: October 23, 2026

Express courier is fastest, commonly 5 to 10 days, but it is priced at retail rates per kilogram and the courier bills you duty, taxes and a clearance fee on arrival. Consolidated air freight takes 7 to 15 days door to door, costs far less per kilogram because many parcels share one shipment, and a duty-paid service can include customs in one price. Courier wins for high-value, urgent items. Air freight wins for almost everything else.

Q: Is DHL faster than air freight from China to Pakistan?
A: Usually by a few days. DHL and similar couriers commonly deliver in 5 to 10 days. Consolidated air freight commonly takes 7 to 15 days door to door.
Q: Why is courier shipping so expensive for one item?
A: Couriers charge retail per parcel rates by weight band, and the first half kilogram carries most of the cost. Air freight shares bulk cargo rates across many parcels.
Q: Who pays customs duty on a DHL parcel in Pakistan?
A: You do. The courier clears the parcel, pays the duty and taxes, then collects them from you with a clearance fee before delivery.
Q: What is volumetric weight?
A: Length times width times height in centimetres divided by 6000 for air freight. If that number is higher than the actual weight, you are charged on it.
Q: Can I choose courier through a sourcing service?
A: Sometimes, for urgent or high-value items. Most services default to consolidated air freight because it is cheaper and still arrives in 7 to 15 days.

## How to Track a Parcel From China to Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-track-a-parcel-from-china-to-pakistan
Category: Shipping
Updated: October 3, 2026

Paste your tracking number into 17track or the carrier's own site. Chinese parcels usually track well until they leave China, then go quiet until Pakistan Post or the courier scans them on arrival, which can be days or weeks later. A status of held at customs means the parcel is waiting for assessment, documents or duty payment. With a duty-paid service you get milestone updates on WhatsApp and nothing to pay at the door.

Q: How do I track an AliExpress parcel in Pakistan?
A: Paste the LP or CN number into 17track or Cainiao. Once it reaches Pakistan, CN numbers also show on the Pakistan Post tracking page.
Q: Why is my parcel from China not updating?
A: After it leaves China there are no scans until the receiving country processes it. For postal parcels that gap is commonly 1 to 3 weeks and is normal.
Q: What does held at customs mean in Pakistan?
A: The parcel is waiting for duty assessment, a document, or payment before release. A few days is routine. Longer than a week means you or the carrier should act.
Q: Can I track a parcel by my order number?
A: Only on the platform or with the service that placed the order. Carriers need the carrier's tracking number, not the order number.
Q: Which local courier delivers parcels from China in Pakistan?
A: For postal parcels, Pakistan Post. For courier and air freight shipments, a domestic courier such as TCS, Leopards or M&P, depending on the forwarder.

## Customs Clearance for Air Cargo in Pakistan: Step by Step
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/customs-clearance-process-pakistan-air-cargo
Category: Customs
Updated: October 3, 2026

When an air shipment lands at Karachi, Lahore or Islamabad, it is manifested, a goods declaration is filed through WeBOC or the Pakistan Single Window, customs assesses value and applies duty and taxes, often using a valuation ruling, the goods may be examined, duty is paid, and the shipment is released for delivery. A courier, a licensed clearing agent or a duty-paid service handles this, not the individual. A routine item takes 1 to 4 working days.

Q: Can an individual clear customs at the airport in Pakistan?
A: Not in practice. Declarations are filed through WeBOC or the Pakistan Single Window by a courier, a licensed clearing agent or a registered importer. Individuals' parcels are declared on their CNIC by the carrier or agent.
Q: What is a valuation ruling?
A: A minimum customs value set by Pakistan Customs for a category of goods. If your invoice is lower, duty is calculated on the ruling value instead.
Q: What is WeBOC?
A: Web Based One Customs, Pakistan's electronic customs declaration system. It is being succeeded by the Pakistan Single Window in stages.
Q: How long does air cargo customs clearance take in Pakistan?
A: Commonly 1 to 4 working days for a routine item. Examination, valuation queries, missing documents or restricted items add time.
Q: Do I need an NTN to receive a parcel from China?
A: No. An NTN and sales tax registration are for commercial import in your own name. A personal parcel is cleared by the courier or agent using your CNIC.

## How to Find the HS Code (PCT Code) for Your Product in Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-find-the-hs-code-for-your-product-pakistan
Category: Customs
Updated: October 23, 2026

An HS code is the international six-digit classification for goods, and Pakistan extends it to an eight-digit PCT code in the Pakistan Customs Tariff. The code decides the customs duty rate, whether regulatory duty applies, whether the item is restricted and whether a CPFTA reduction exists. Find it in the FBR tariff, from the seller's export code, or from a clearing agent or import service, and confirm it before you pay.

Q: What is the difference between an HS code and a PCT code?
A: HS is the international six-digit code. PCT is Pakistan's eight-digit extension of it in the Pakistan Customs Tariff. The first six digits are the same.
Q: Where can I find the Pakistan Customs Tariff?
A: On the FBR website as a published tariff document, and within WeBOC. Clearing agents and import services also have it to hand.
Q: Can I use the HS code the Chinese seller gives me?
A: The first six digits are a good starting point. Pakistan's eight-digit line and the duty rate still need to be checked against the current tariff and rulings.
Q: What happens if I declare the wrong HS code?
A: Customs reassesses under the code it considers correct and recalculates duty. A deliberate misdeclaration can attract a penalty.
Q: Does the HS code decide whether an item is allowed into Pakistan?
A: Partly. The Import Policy Order lists restrictions by code, so the code shows whether conditions such as PTA approval or prior permission apply.

## Parcel Stuck at Customs in Pakistan: Why It Happens and What to Do
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/parcel-stuck-at-customs-pakistan-what-to-do
Category: Customs
Updated: October 3, 2026

A parcel is held at customs in Pakistan for a handful of reasons: customs disputes the declared value, the item is restricted (a phone, drone, medicine or branded lookalike), a document such as the invoice is missing or vague, or the item contains a battery. Find out which from the carrier, supply what is asked, pay the assessed duty, and if the item is not permitted, choose between return and abandonment. A duty-paid service handles all of this for you.

Q: Why is my parcel from China held at customs in Pakistan?
A: Most often because duty has been assessed and is awaiting payment, customs wants proof of value, the item is restricted, a document is missing, or it contains a battery.
Q: How do I pay customs duty on a held parcel?
A: To the courier, who pays customs and bills you with a fee, or on the Pakistan Post demand notice. Pay promptly to avoid storage charges.
Q: Can I get my money back if customs seizes my parcel?
A: Not from customs. A platform dispute may refund non-delivery, but seizure of a prohibited or counterfeit item is usually treated as the buyer's risk.
Q: How long can a parcel stay at customs in Pakistan?
A: A few working days is routine. Beyond that, storage charges may apply, and uncleared goods are eventually treated as unclaimed and disposed of after notice.
Q: Can I avoid customs holds by marking the parcel as a gift?
A: No. Pakistan has no meaningful duty-free threshold for parcels, and a vague gift label makes a hold more likely, not less.

## China-Pakistan Free Trade Agreement (CPFTA) Explained for Buyers
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/china-pakistan-free-trade-agreement-cpfta-explained
Category: Customs
Updated: October 23, 2026

The China-Pakistan Free Trade Agreement (CPFTA) reduces or removes customs duty on listed goods made in China when the shipment carries a valid Certificate of Origin issued in China. It does not reduce sales tax, additional customs duty or advance income tax, which still apply in full. For a single item, the certificate is rarely available from a marketplace seller, so most one-off parcels pay the normal duty rate. The saving is real for registered importers moving commercial volumes.

Q: Does CPFTA make imports from China tax free?
A: No. It reduces or removes customs duty on listed goods with a Certificate of Origin. Sales tax, additional customs duty, regulatory duty and advance income tax still apply.
Q: Who issues the Certificate of Origin for CPFTA?
A: Authorised bodies in China, commonly CCPIT or China Customs, on application by the exporter for a specific shipment.
Q: Can I get a Certificate of Origin for an AliExpress or Taobao order?
A: Almost never. Marketplace sellers do not apply for preferential certificates for single pieces. One-off parcels are assessed at the normal duty rate.
Q: Are all Chinese goods covered by the CPFTA?
A: No. Coverage is by PCT code, Pakistan kept a protected list, and the goods must meet rules of origin. Check the current treatment for your code.
Q: Does CPFTA apply to phones and electronics?
A: Some electronic lines are covered and some are not, and phones still need PTA registration and tax regardless. Confirm the specific PCT code.

## Refunds and Returns When Importing From China to Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/refunds-and-returns-when-importing-from-china
Category: Guide
Updated: October 3, 2026

There is no cheap way to return an item from Pakistan to China, so returns in the Daraz sense do not exist. Realistic options are a platform dispute for non-delivery or a clear mismatch, a seller-funded replacement or partial refund, or a transit damage claim. A single-item service contacts the seller and raises the dispute for you, but cannot promise a refund the seller or platform will not give. Getting the right item first time is the best protection.

Q: Can I return an AliExpress item from Pakistan?
A: You can, at your own cost by courier, but the postage usually exceeds the refund. Most buyers settle for a partial refund through a dispute instead.
Q: What happens if my item from China never arrives?
A: Open a dispute on the platform before the protection window closes. Non-delivery claims with tracking evidence are usually refunded.
Q: Will a Chinese seller send a replacement?
A: Often, for a wrong variant, missing part or dead-on-arrival item with photo evidence. Rarely for quality expectations, size or colour.
Q: Does a sourcing service guarantee refunds?
A: No. It contacts the seller and raises disputes on your behalf, but it cannot force a refund the seller or platform will not give.
Q: Who pays for a replacement to be shipped again?
A: Sellers usually cover shipping inside China. International freight for the replacement is normally the buyer's cost unless the seller agrees otherwise.

## Chinese New Year and 11.11: When Shipping From China Slows Down
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/chinese-new-year-and-11-11-shipping-delays
Category: Shipping
Updated: October 3, 2026

Chinese New Year falls between late January and mid February and most factories and many sellers close for roughly two to four weeks around it, so orders placed then wait until business resumes. The 11.11 sale on 11 November and the 618 sale in June create huge volumes, and dispatch and freight are slower for one to three weeks afterwards. Order at least three weeks before Chinese New Year or wait until late February, and avoid the fortnight after 11.11.

Q: How long do Chinese factories close for Chinese New Year?
A: The public holiday is about a week, but production and dispatch commonly stop for two to four weeks between late January and mid February. Dates change each year.
Q: Can I order from China during Chinese New Year?
A: You can pay, but most sellers dispatch only after they reopen, so the order waits. Expect delivery in Pakistan several weeks later than normal.
Q: Is 11.11 a good time to buy one item from China?
A: Prices are lower, but dispatch and freight are slower for one to three weeks afterwards. Good if you can wait, bad if you need it by a date.
Q: What is the 618 sale?
A: China's mid-year online sale around 18 June. It causes a smaller version of the 11.11 slowdown, roughly one to two weeks.
Q: Does shipping cost more around Chinese New Year and 11.11?
A: Air cargo space is tighter and some forwarders apply peak surcharges, so freight can cost more. Delivered rupee quotes in these periods reflect that.

## RMB to PKR: How Prices Work When You Import From China
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/rmb-to-pkr-how-prices-work-when-importing
Category: Payments
Updated: October 3, 2026

Chinese sellers price in renminbi (RMB, yuan or CNY) on 1688 and Taobao, and in US dollars on Alibaba and AliExpress. Your rupee cost is that price converted at the rate on the day you pay, plus any conversion fee your bank adds. Because the rupee moves against both currencies, a rupee quote is only accurate for a short period, which is why a delivered PKR price comes with a validity window. Paying promptly locks the number.

Q: Do Chinese sellers accept Pakistani rupees?
A: No. Prices are in yuan on 1688 and Taobao and in dollars on Alibaba and AliExpress. Rupees are only used when you pay a Pakistani service that converts on its side.
Q: Why did my card charge more rupees than the price shown?
A: Your bank converted at its own rate on the settlement date and added a foreign transaction fee. The platform's rupee display is an estimate.
Q: Why is a rupee quote only valid for a few days?
A: Because it converts a yuan or dollar cost at today's rate. If the rupee moves before you pay, the same cost needs a different number of rupees.
Q: Does the exchange rate affect customs duty?
A: Yes. Duty and sales tax are calculated on the customs value in rupees, so a weaker rupee raises both the item cost and the tax on it.
Q: Is it cheaper to pay in dollars or yuan?
A: It depends on your bank's rates for each. For most Pakistani card holders the difference is small compared with the foreign transaction fee itself.

## Can I Import a Laptop From China to Pakistan? Duty, Warranty, Keyboard
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-a-laptop-from-china-to-pakistan
Category: Products
Updated: October 3, 2026

Yes. A single laptop can be imported from China to Pakistan by air because its lithium battery is built in, and laptops do not need PTA registration. You pay customs duty and taxes on the landed value, the brand warranty is usually valid in China only, and China-market models often ship with a Chinese single-language edition of Windows. Check the Windows edition, keyboard and exact spec before you pay.

Q: Do I need PTA approval to import a laptop into Pakistan?
A: No. PTA registration applies to devices with a SIM and IMEI, such as phones. A standard Wi-Fi laptop needs no PTA step. Only laptops with a built-in cellular modem might, so check that variant with PTA.
Q: Can a laptop be shipped by air from China because of the battery?
A: Yes. A battery built into the laptop is accepted on normal air routes. Loose spare batteries and power banks are restricted, so order the laptop alone.
Q: Is customs duty charged on one laptop from China?
A: Yes. Duty, additional duty, sales tax and advance income tax are charged on the customs value. There is no duty-free threshold for parcels. Confirm the current rate because it changes with budgets.
Q: Will the warranty work in Pakistan?
A: Usually not. China-market laptops carry a China-only warranty and Pakistani service centres generally treat them as paid repairs. Confirm international warranty for the exact model before buying.
Q: Can I change Chinese Windows to English?
A: Not on the Chinese single-language edition without changing edition or reinstalling. Ask the seller for an English or global edition, or a model with no operating system, before you order.

## Importing a Mobile Phone From China to Pakistan: PTA Tax and ROM
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-a-mobile-phone-from-china-to-pakistan-pta
Category: Products
Updated: October 3, 2026

You can import one phone from China to Pakistan, but it must be registered with PTA through DIRBS and the PTA tax paid, otherwise it is blocked on Pakistani networks after a grace period. The tax depends on the exact model and often cancels the saving on mid-range and flagship phones. China-market phones also run a Chinese ROM without Google services, so check for a global ROM version before you buy.

Q: Do I have to pay PTA tax on a phone imported from China?
A: Yes, if you want to use it on a Pakistani mobile network. The phone must be registered on DIRBS and the model-based tax paid, or it is blocked after the grace period.
Q: How much is the PTA tax on an imported phone?
A: It depends on the exact model and changes with policy. Look up the current amount for your model on PTA's official channels. On flagships it is often a large share of the phone's price.
Q: What is the difference between a Chinese ROM and a global ROM?
A: A China ROM is built for the Chinese market: usually no Google services, Chinese system apps and sometimes different network bands. A global ROM has Google services and multi-language support. Buy the global version where it exists.
Q: Can I use a China-market phone on Wi-Fi only without PTA registration?
A: Yes. The DIRBS block affects mobile network use only. Wi-Fi continues to work, but most buyers want a phone that works as a phone.
Q: Is a phone imported from China cheaper than buying in Pakistan?
A: Sometimes. Add the PTA tax, shipping and customs to the China price and compare with the local price. On many mid-range and flagship models the saving disappears. It is most worthwhile for models not sold in Pakistan.

## Can I Import Earbuds or a Smartwatch From China to Pakistan?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-earbuds-smartwatch-wearables-from-china
Category: Products
Updated: October 3, 2026

Yes. Earbuds, smartwatches and fitness bands are among the easiest single items to import from China to Pakistan because their batteries are built in and air carriers accept them. Customs duty still applies even on cheap items. The two things that go wrong are buying a counterfeit of a famous brand, which customs seizes, and buying a China-market version whose companion app, language or features do not work properly in Pakistan.

Q: Can earbuds with batteries be shipped by air from China to Pakistan?
A: Yes. Earbuds and their charging case have built-in batteries, which air carriers accept on standard lines. Only loose batteries and power banks are restricted.
Q: Will Pakistani customs seize fake AirPods or Apple Watch copies?
A: Yes. Counterfeit branded goods are prohibited and seized without compensation. Buy genuine Chinese brands sold under their own names instead.
Q: Does a smartwatch from China need PTA registration?
A: Only if it has a SIM or eSIM and therefore an IMEI. Standard Bluetooth smartwatches and fitness bands do not. Check cellular models with PTA before ordering.
Q: Will the Chinese smartwatch app work in Pakistan?
A: Not always. China-market devices often need the China version of the app, which may be unavailable or in Chinese. Buy the global version of the device where one exists.
Q: Is customs duty charged on cheap earbuds from China?
A: Yes. There is no duty-free threshold for parcels in Pakistan. Duty, sales tax and advance income tax apply on the customs value, and customs may use a minimum valuation for small electronics.

## Importing PC Parts From China to Pakistan: GPUs, CPUs, Keyboards
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-gaming-pc-parts-gpu-from-china-to-pakistan
Category: Products
Updated: October 3, 2026

Yes, you can import a single GPU, CPU, motherboard, RAM kit, SSD or mechanical keyboard from China to Pakistan. None of these contain restricted batteries (wireless keyboards have built-in ones, which are fine). Customs duty and taxes apply on the landed value, there is no warranty support in Pakistan for grey imports, and the biggest risk with graphics cards is used or mining stock sold as new. Buy from rated sellers and specify the exact SKU.

Q: Can I import a single graphics card from China to Pakistan?
A: Yes. A GPU has no battery and is not restricted. Duty and taxes apply on arrival, there is no local warranty, and you should buy from an official brand store to avoid used cards sold as new.
Q: Is there warranty on PC parts imported from China?
A: Only in China. Pakistani distributors generally do not service grey imports. Treat any fault as your own cost when deciding whether the saving is worth it.
Q: How do I avoid buying a used mining GPU from China?
A: Buy from the brand's official store or a high-volume rated seller, ask for the serial number and a sealed retail box, and avoid any listing far below the market price.
Q: Can a wireless mechanical keyboard ship by air?
A: Yes. The battery is built into the keyboard, which air carriers accept. Check the layout and whether the configuration software has an English version or the board supports VIA or QMK.
Q: Is it worth importing a PC case or monitor from China?
A: Usually not for a single unit. Both are bulky, monitors are fragile, and air freight is priced by weight and volume. The local price often wins once freight is added.

## Importing Car and Bike Spare Parts From China to Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-car-and-bike-spare-parts-from-china-to-pakistan
Category: Products
Updated: October 3, 2026

Yes, you can import a single car or bike spare part from China to Pakistan, and for Chinese-brand vehicles or discontinued parts it is often the only option. Success depends on the OEM part number, confirming fitment for a right-hand-drive vehicle, and avoiding counterfeit branded parts, which customs seizes. Small parts ship cheaply by air; heavy or bulky parts such as bumpers, panels and rims can cost more in freight than they are worth.

Q: Can I import a single car part from China to Pakistan?
A: Yes. One part is a normal import. You pay duty and taxes on the landed value, and the main risks are a wrong part number, a left-hand-drive version and counterfeit branded parts.
Q: How do I make sure a part from China fits my car?
A: Use the OEM part number, give the seller your VIN, model year and engine code, and send a photo of the old part. For anything with a left and right, confirm right-hand-drive fitment explicitly.
Q: Will customs seize fake branded car parts?
A: Yes. Parts carrying a vehicle brand's logo at a fraction of the dealer price are counterfeit and are seized without compensation. Buy OEM-supplier or known aftermarket brands instead.
Q: Is it worth importing a bumper or body panel from China?
A: Rarely for a single piece. Air freight is charged on volume for large light parts and often exceeds the part's price. Sea freight is uneconomical below about one cubic metre.
Q: Can car batteries, airbags or brake fluid be shipped from China by air?
A: Generally not on standard air routes. Batteries, airbag modules and flammable fluids are restricted and need special handling, which is impractical for a single part.

## Importing Machine and Appliance Replacement Parts From China
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-machine-and-appliance-replacement-parts-from-china
Category: Products
Updated: October 3, 2026

Yes. A single replacement part for an appliance, machine or tool is one of the best single-item imports from China to Pakistan: it is small, light, specific, and often the only way to get a discontinued or locally unavailable part. Success depends on the appliance model number, the part number or markings on the old part, clear photos and measurements. Duty applies on the landed value, and the main risk is a near-identical variant that does not fit.

Q: Can I import a single replacement part for my appliance from China?
A: Yes. One part is a normal import and often the only way to get a discontinued board, motor or gasket. Duty applies on the landed value and the main risk is a variant that does not fit.
Q: What information do I need to find the right part on Chinese sites?
A: The appliance model number from its rating plate, the part number or markings on the old part, clear photos including connectors, measurements in millimetres and the voltage and wattage.
Q: Can a control board be shipped by air from China?
A: Yes. PCBs ship normally in antistatic packaging. Only loose battery packs, strong magnets and parts containing oil or gas face air restrictions.
Q: How much duty is charged on a small appliance part?
A: Duty depends on the HS code, plus sales tax and advance income tax on the customs value. For a small, low-value part the absolute amount is usually small even though the combined percentage can be 25 to 60 percent. Confirm the current rate.
Q: What if the part does not fit?
A: There is no practical return or exchange route from Pakistan. Prevent it by sending the seller the model number, part markings, photos and measurements before ordering.

## Importing Kitchen and Home Appliances From China: Voltage and Plugs
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-kitchen-and-home-appliances-from-china-voltage
Category: Products
Updated: October 3, 2026

Yes. Most appliances sold for the Chinese market run on 220V 50Hz, the same as Pakistan, so they work here with a simple plug adapter. Avoid 110V US-market versions, which need a bulky converter. Small and medium appliances such as air fryers, rice cookers, blenders, robot vacuums and coffee machines ship well by air; large or heavy items lose their saving to freight. Check the voltage label, the plug type and whether the controls and app are in Chinese.

Q: Do Chinese appliances work on Pakistani electricity?
A: Yes, if they are the 220V version. China and Pakistan both use 220V 50Hz mains. You only need a plug adapter for the pin shape. Avoid 110V US-market versions.
Q: Do I need a voltage converter for an appliance from China?
A: Not for a 220V Chinese-market appliance. You need a converter only for 110V items, and for heating appliances the converter is large and expensive, so buy the 220V version instead.
Q: Which plug adapter do I need for Chinese appliances?
A: Chinese plugs are type A, C or I. Pakistani sockets are type C and D. Type C fits directly in many sockets; type A and I need a cheap adapter. Use an earthed adapter for three-pin appliances.
Q: Is it worth importing a refrigerator or washing machine from China?
A: Usually not as a single item. Freight on large heavy appliances is high, they are fragile, and there is no local service. Small and medium appliances are the sensible single imports.
Q: Will a Chinese smart appliance work with the app in Pakistan?
A: Not always. China-market devices often connect to the China server of the brand's app, which the Pakistani app store version may not support. Ask for the global or international version.

## Importing Clothes and Shoes From China to Pakistan: Sizing and Fit
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-clothes-and-shoes-from-china-sizing
Category: Products
Updated: October 3, 2026

Yes, you can import a single garment or pair of shoes from China to Pakistan, and it is cheap to ship by air. The risks are fit and expectation: Chinese sizes run smaller than UK or US sizes, so order by the seller's centimetre measurements, not the label. There is no exchange route from Pakistan, fabric quality can differ from the photos, and branded lookalikes are seized by customs. Duty applies even on cheap clothing.

Q: Do Chinese clothing sizes run small?
A: Yes. A Chinese L is often closer to a UK or US M. Ignore the letter and order by the seller's centimetre measurements compared with a garment you own that fits.
Q: How do I choose shoe size when buying from China?
A: Measure your foot length in centimetres standing on paper, add about half a centimetre, and match it to the foot length column on the seller's chart. Mention a wide foot to the seller.
Q: Can I return or exchange clothes bought from China?
A: Not in practice. Return shipping from Pakistan costs more than most garments and sellers rarely accept it. Treat every order as final and measure carefully.
Q: Will customs seize fake Nike or Adidas shoes from China?
A: Yes. Counterfeit branded goods are prohibited and seized without compensation. Buy unbranded or Chinese-brand items instead.
Q: Is duty charged on a single piece of clothing from China?
A: Yes. There is no duty-free threshold for parcels. Duty, sales tax and advance income tax apply on the customs value, and customs may use a minimum valuation per piece.

## Importing Anime Figures and Collectibles From China to Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-anime-figures-and-collectibles-from-china
Category: Products
Updated: October 3, 2026

Yes. A single anime figure, model kit, trading card box or designer toy can be imported from China to Pakistan, and Taobao is the main source because Chinese collectors buy the same licensed releases at domestic prices. The risks are bootlegs, which are poor quality and can be treated as counterfeits by customs, box damage in transit, and long pre-order waits. Duty applies on the landed value. Buy licensed items from official or highly rated stores.

Q: Can I buy anime figures from Taobao in Pakistan?
A: Yes, through an agent. Taobao ships within China only and takes Chinese payment, so an agent buys the figure, receives it in China and forwards it to you.
Q: How do I tell a bootleg figure from a licensed one?
A: Price far below retail, listings that avoid the maker's name, stock photos only and no authenticity sticker are the usual signs. Buy from official Tmall brand stores or licensed retailers.
Q: Will customs seize a bootleg figure?
A: It can. Bootlegs infringe trademarks and may be treated as counterfeit goods, which are prohibited. Even if one gets through, the quality is poor.
Q: Is customs duty charged on an anime figure?
A: Yes. Figures and model kits are dutiable, with sales tax and advance income tax on the customs value. Confirm the current rate because it changes with budgets.
Q: Can I pre-order a figure from China through a service?
A: Usually yes, but clarify how payment and timing work before committing. Releases can slip by months and a rupee price quoted far in advance is exposed to exchange rate movement.

## Importing Camera and Photography Gear From China to Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-camera-and-photography-gear-from-china
Category: Products
Updated: October 3, 2026

Yes. Lenses, tripods, gimbals, LED lights, microphones and accessories from Chinese brands such as Viltrox, TTArtisan, Godox, Zhiyun, SmallRig and Ulanzi can be imported one at a time from China to Pakistan. Devices with built-in batteries ship by air normally; loose spare batteries and V-mount packs are restricted. Customs duty applies on the landed value, warranty is grey-market, and drones are a separate problem that needs prior permission.

Q: Can I import a camera lens from China to Pakistan?
A: Yes. Lenses have no battery and are not restricted. Duty and taxes apply on the landed value. Specify the exact mount in writing because listings cover several mounts.
Q: Can a gimbal or LED light with a battery ship by air from China?
A: Yes, if the battery is built into the device. Loose spare batteries, NP-F packs, V-mount packs and power banks are restricted and should be bought locally.
Q: Is there warranty on camera gear imported from China?
A: It is a China warranty. Pakistani distributors generally do not service grey imports. Some Chinese brands offer international warranty on specific products, so check the brand's site for your model.
