Q: How much is customs duty on photography equipment?
A: It depends on the HS code for the item. Duty, additional duty, sales tax and advance income tax together commonly add 25 to 60 percent of the customs value. Confirm the current rate because it changes.

## How to Import One Item From China to Lahore
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-from-china-to-lahore
Category: Cities
Updated: October 23, 2026

A single item from China reaches Lahore by air. It flies into Allama Iqbal International Airport in Lahore or into Karachi and then travels by road, clears Pakistan Customs, and a local courier delivers it to your door. Door to door, this commonly takes 7 to 15 days after the seller dispatches. A single-item service gives you one rupee price for the whole journey, paid once, before it ships.

Q: How long does a parcel from China take to reach Lahore?
A: By air, commonly 7 to 15 days door to door after the seller dispatches, including customs. Ordinary post from AliExpress takes 25 to 45 days.
Q: Does the parcel fly directly into Lahore airport?
A: Sometimes. Many lines fly into Karachi, which has more cargo capacity, and then move the parcel to Lahore by road. Delivery time is similar either way.
Q: Do I need to go to the airport or customs in Lahore to collect it?
A: No. For a single item, the courier or agent clears customs using your CNIC and a local courier delivers to your door.
Q: Do I pay anything on delivery in Lahore?
A: With a single-item service, no. You pay one price before it ships and nothing at the door. If you order direct from AliExpress or Alibaba, the courier may bill you duty on arrival.
Q: Can I order in bulk for my shop in Lahore?
A: Not through us. We handle one item per order for personal use. Bulk import needs commercial registration and a freight forwarder.

## How to Import One Item From China to Karachi
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-from-china-to-karachi
Category: Cities
Updated: October 3, 2026

Karachi is Pakistan's main gateway for goods from China. A single item flies into Jinnah International Airport, clears Pakistan Customs, and a local courier delivers it to your Karachi address, commonly within 7 to 15 days after the seller dispatches. Heavy or bulky goods arrive by sea through Karachi Port or Port Qasim, but for one item air is almost always the practical route. A single-item service gives you one rupee price for all of it, paid once.

Q: How long does a parcel from China take to reach Karachi?
A: By consolidated air freight, commonly 7 to 15 days door to door after dispatch, including customs. Karachi is often at the quicker end because the parcel lands in the city.
Q: Is sea freight cheaper for a single item because Karachi has ports?
A: Rarely. Sea is priced per cubic metre with a minimum of about 1 CBM plus fixed port fees, so a single small item costs more by sea than by air and takes 25 to 45 days.
Q: Do I need to visit the airport or port in Karachi to collect my item?
A: No. The courier or agent clears customs with your CNIC and a local courier delivers to your door.
Q: Is there anything to pay on delivery in Karachi?
A: Not with a single-item service. You pay one price before shipping. Ordering direct from AliExpress or Alibaba can mean a duty bill from the courier on arrival.
Q: Can I import stock for resale in Karachi through you?
A: No. We handle one item per order for personal use. Resale stock is commercial import and needs NTN, STRN and WeBOC registration.

## Can You Import One Solar Panel or Inverter From China to Pakistan?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-solar-panels-inverters-from-china-single-unit
Category: Products
Updated: October 3, 2026

A single inverter from China is a realistic import to Pakistan, because it is compact enough for air freight and the saving on a specific model can justify the cost. A single solar panel rarely is, because it is large, fragile and heavy, which makes air expensive and sea uneconomical for one piece. Lithium batteries are restricted by air. Duty and tax rules on solar equipment in Pakistan change often, so always confirm the current position before paying.

Q: Can I import one solar panel from China to Pakistan?
A: You can, but it is rarely economical. The panel's size makes air freight expensive and sea freight has a minimum charge of about 1 CBM. Buying one panel locally is usually cheaper.
Q: Can I import a single solar inverter from China?
A: Yes. An inverter is compact enough for air freight and a specific model can be worth importing. Check voltage, grid approval for net metering, and accept that the warranty is effectively void.
Q: Can lithium solar batteries be shipped from China by air?
A: Generally no. Loose lithium batteries are restricted by air. Sea or special battery lines are the alternatives, which do not suit a single unit.
Q: How much is customs duty on solar equipment in Pakistan?
A: It changes often with budgets and SROs. Check the current tariff for the specific HS code or ask for a delivered price that includes the current duty and taxes.
Q: Will a Chinese inverter work on Pakistan's grid?
A: Most are built for 220 to 240V 50Hz, which matches Pakistan. Confirm the model is not a 110V or 60Hz variant and check your DISCO's approved list if you plan to net meter.

Small fitness gear from China is a good single-item import to Pakistan: resistance bands, grips, jump ropes, smartwatches, massage guns and boxing gloves are light and ship by air in 7 to 15 days. Heavy equipment such as treadmills, benches, racks and plate sets is usually not worth importing as one unit, because freight is charged on weight and often exceeds the saving. Ask for a delivered price before deciding.

Q: Can I import a treadmill from China to Pakistan for home use?

Q: Is it worth importing dumbbells or plates from China?

Q: Can a smartwatch or massage gun be shipped by air?
A: Yes. Devices with built-in batteries ship by air normally. Loose spare batteries and power banks are restricted.
Q: Can I import protein powder or supplements from China?
A: Not advisable. Supplements fall under DRAP rules and parcels are often held or destroyed at customs.
Q: How long does fitness gear take to arrive from China?

## Importing Skincare Devices and Cosmetics From China to Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-cosmetics-and-skincare-devices-from-china
Category: Products
Updated: October 3, 2026

Beauty devices from China, such as LED masks, sonic facial cleansers, microcurrent tools, hair stylers and dermaplaning pens, are good single-item imports to Pakistan because they are light, electronic and ship by air. Creams, serums, liquids and aerosols are a different matter: air carriers restrict many of them and anything medicated falls under DRAP, so parcels are often held. Avoid branded cosmetics at low prices, which are counterfeit and seized.

Q: Can I import an LED face mask from China to Pakistan?

Q: Can I import skincare creams or serums from China?

Q: Can perfume be shipped from China to Pakistan by air?
A: Generally no. Perfumes and aerosols are flammable and most consolidated air lines refuse them.
Q: Are cheap branded cosmetics from Taobao or DHgate genuine?
A: No. Famous brands at a fraction of retail are counterfeit, and Pakistan Customs seizes counterfeits. Buy genuine Chinese brands or unbranded devices.
Q: Will a Chinese hair straightener work in Pakistan?
A: Most Chinese models are 220V and match Pakistan's 220 to 240V 50Hz supply. Check the label, avoid 110V variants, and use a plug adapter.

Category: Products
Updated: October 3, 2026

A single toy or baby product from China is usually an easy import to Pakistan: building sets, educational toys, ride-ons, strollers, carriers and nursery gadgets ship by air and clear customs without special permits. The buyer's job is safety, because there is no local recourse once it arrives. Check for recognised safety marks, avoid counterfeits, and never import infant formula, medicines or anything a baby swallows.

Q: Can I import toys from China to Pakistan for my own child?
A: Yes. Toys are allowed and a single unit for personal use needs no licence. Check safety marks and age grading in the listing, because there is no local return or recall.
Q: Can I import baby formula from China?
A: No. Infant formula faces food safety and regulatory holds and you cannot verify storage or authenticity. Buy formula locally.
Q: Can I import a stroller from China to Pakistan?
A: Yes, but strollers are bulky and air freight is charged on volumetric weight. Ask for a delivered price and compare with local options before deciding.
Q: Are Chinese toys safe?
A: Many are, especially from exporters who label CE, EN71 or ASTM compliance. Avoid cheap unbranded electrical toys, loose magnets and counterfeits, which have no testing behind them.
Q: Can I import a toy drone for my child?
A: Not advisable. Drones and camera quadcopters are routinely held by Pakistan Customs without prior permission. RC cars and boats are fine.

## Chinese Brands Worth Buying Directly From China (And Fakes to Avoid)
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/chinese-brands-worth-buying-from-china
Category: Sourcing
Updated: October 3, 2026

The safe way to buy branded goods from China is to buy Chinese brands under their own names: Xiaomi, Anker, Ugreen, Baseus, Lenovo, Haylou, Soundcore, Redmi, Dreame, Roborock and many more. They are genuine, priced for the Chinese market and clear Pakistan Customs normally. Famous Western, Japanese or Korean brands at a fraction of retail on Chinese marketplaces are counterfeit and are seized. Buy from official brand stores on Tmall, JD or Taobao where possible.

Q: Are Xiaomi, Anker and Ugreen products from China genuine?
A: Yes, when bought from the brand's official store on Tmall, JD, Taobao or AliExpress, or from a rated seller at a normal price. A price far below the official store is a warning sign.
Q: Can I import a Xiaomi phone from China to Pakistan?
A: You can, but every phone used in Pakistan must be registered with PTA and the tax paid after a grace period. Check the PTA tax for the model first and ask whether it is the global or China version.
Q: Why are Western brands so cheap on Taobao and 1688?
A: Because they are counterfeit. Pakistan Customs seizes counterfeits. Buy Chinese brands under their own names instead.
Q: Do Chinese brands have warranty in Pakistan?
A: Only if you buy through the Pakistani distributor. An item imported from China has no local warranty in practice.
Q: Can I buy from Tmall or JD from Pakistan?
A: Not directly. They ship within China and accept Chinese payment only. A sourcing service with a Chinese address and payment method buys it for you.

## How to Send a Gift From China to Someone in Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/gift-shipping-from-china-to-someone-in-pakistan
Category: Guide
Updated: October 3, 2026

You can send a single item from China to a relative or friend in Pakistan by giving a single-item service the product link and the receiver's full address, phone number and CNIC. You pay once and the receiver pays nothing on delivery. Pakistan has no meaningful gift exemption from duty on parcels, so duty is included in the price you pay. Allow 7 to 15 days after dispatch, more around Eid and Chinese New Year.

Q: Can I send a gift from China to Pakistan without the receiver paying anything?
A: Yes. With a single-item service you pay one price upfront that includes duty, and the receiver pays nothing on delivery.
Q: Is there a gift allowance for customs duty in Pakistan?
A: Not for a parcel bought from a seller and shipped as cargo. It is assessed as an import regardless of the word gift. Duty and taxes are included in the delivered price.
Q: Does the receiver need to give their CNIC?
A: Yes. Customs clearance for an individual's parcel uses the receiver's CNIC number. They do not need to visit anywhere.
Q: How long before Eid should I order a gift from China?
A: At least three to four weeks. Allow 7 to 15 days for delivery after dispatch plus seller handling, and avoid the congested final week before Eid.
Q: Can I send a phone as a gift to Pakistan?
A: You can, but the receiver must register it with PTA and pay the PTA tax after a grace period or it is blocked on networks. A smartwatch or earbuds avoid that.

Q: Does the Moondrop Aria 2 have a microphone?
A: No. Moondrop's package list has no mic cable. You can buy a separate 0.78mm 2-pin cable with a mic if you need calls.

A: The Aria 2 is the newer model with a different diaphragm, an unpainted metal shell and a modular cable with 3.5mm and 4.4mm plugs. Check listing titles carefully because both are still sold.

## AliExpress Choice Explained for Buyers in Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/aliexpress-choice-explained-for-pakistan
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 23, 2026

AliExpress Choice is a section of products that AliExpress itself prices, stores, ships and supports, instead of leaving it all to the seller. In the markets where it is fully rolled out, it comes with free shipping thresholds, delivery guarantees and free returns. Pakistan has not been named in any of the Choice announcements we could find, so for a Pakistani address treat the badge as a sign of a managed listing, not a promise of free returns or fast delivery. Check the order page before paying.

Q: Is AliExpress Choice available in Pakistan?
A: Choice items can be bought and shipped to Pakistan, but the headline perks such as free returns and delivery guarantees were announced for named markets that do not include Pakistan. Check the checkout page for what applies to your address.
Q: Does the Choice badge mean the product is genuine?
A: No. Choice means AliExpress manages pricing, shipping and after-sales for that listing. It is not a brand authenticity mark.
Q: How long does a Choice order take to reach Pakistan?
A: There is no published Pakistan delivery guarantee. AliExpress parcels to Pakistan commonly take 25 to 45 days by post, and Choice may be at the faster end.
Q: Can I return a Choice item for free from Pakistan?
A: Free Choice returns have only been confirmed for selected markets, and Pakistan is not among those named. Expect to rely on a normal dispute instead.
Q: Will I pay customs on a Choice parcel?
A: Possibly. Duties are only waived where goods arriving by post or courier are valued at one thousand rupees or less, so most purchases above that can be assessed.
Q: Why is the Choice price fixed?
A: Because AliExpress sets Choice prices itself instead of the seller, so there is no room to negotiate with the merchant.

## How to Use 1688 in English: Translate, Search and Read Prices
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-use-1688-in-english
Category: Sourcing
Updated: October 11, 2026

1688 has no official English version, but you can use it well in Chrome with page translation, search it by uploading a photo, and read prices once you understand MOQ (起批) and quantity tiers. What translation cannot fix is buying: 1688 expects a Chinese Alipay account, Chinese payment methods and a delivery address inside China. So most people in Pakistan use 1688 to find and compare items, then hand the link to an agent who buys and ships it.

Q: Does 1688 have an English version?
A: No official one. You can translate the site in Chrome or Edge, and global.1688.com shows a selection of suppliers for overseas buyers.
Q: Can I search 1688 with a photo?
A: Yes. Click the camera icon at the right of the search bar on the website, or in the app, and upload a clear product photo.
Q: What does 起批 mean on 1688?
A: It means the minimum order quantity, literally a starting batch. 2件起批 means the first price applies from 2 pieces.
Q: Can I pay 1688 sellers from Pakistan?
A: Most sellers expect Alipay, WeChat Pay or a Chinese bank transfer. Some services let overseas buyers pay participating suppliers, but JazzCash, Easypaisa and Raast do not work.
Q: Will a 1688 seller ship to Pakistan?
A: Almost never. Most 1688 sellers deliver only inside China, so an agent receives the parcel in China and sends it on.
Q: Can I buy just one item from 1688?
A: Sometimes, if the minimum is low or the seller agrees to a sample. You will pay the highest price tier, and you still need someone in China to buy and ship it.

## How to Read a Taobao or 1688 Listing (With Chinese Terms)
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-read-a-taobao-or-1688-listing
Category: Guide
Updated: October 11, 2026

Read a Taobao or 1688 listing in this order: pick the exact variant first, because each colour and size is a separate SKU with its own price and stock; read the specifications table rather than the title; check the seller's store rating, age and badges; look at where it ships from; then read the bad reviews. A handful of Chinese words such as 颜色分类, 起批, 现货, 预售, 发货 and 包邮 tell you most of what matters, and they are listed in the table below.

Q: What does 颜色分类 mean on Taobao?
A: It is the variant selector, literally colour category. Sellers also use it for models, bundles and plug types, and each choice can have its own price.
Q: What is the difference between 现货 and 预售?
A: 现货 means in stock and ready to ship. 预售 means pre-sale, so the item ships later, sometimes weeks later.
Q: Does 包邮 mean free shipping to Pakistan?
A: No. 包邮 means shipping is included within mainland China only. International shipping is always extra.
Q: Where are the specifications on a Taobao listing?
A: Under the details tab, in a parameter table labelled 参数 or 规格参数. It is more reliable than the title.
Q: How do I know if a Taobao seller is reliable?
A: Check the store rating, store age, response time and negative reviews. For branded items, buy from a Tmall official flagship store where possible.
Q: What does 发货地 tell me?
A: It is the city the item ships from inside China. It affects how fast the item reaches the agent's warehouse.

## How to Spot Fake Listings on AliExpress and Taobao
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-spot-fake-listings-on-aliexpress-and-taobao
Category: Sourcing
Updated: October 11, 2026

A fake listing usually gives itself away in four places: a branded item priced far below the brand's own price, photos copied from the brand or another seller, a store that is not the brand's official store, and reviews that do not match the product. On Taobao, buy branded goods from a Tmall official flagship store. On AliExpress, reach the brand's store from the brand's own website. Anything else selling a famous brand cheaply should be treated as a copy.

Q: Are Tmall stores safer than Taobao shops?
A: For branded goods, yes. Tmall merchants are brand owners or authorised distributors, while anyone can open a Taobao shop.
Q: Is everything cheap on AliExpress fake?
A: No. Cheap unbranded goods are simply unbranded. The risk is a famous brand name sold far below the brand's own price.
Q: What does 高仿 mean?
A: It means a quality fake. A listing using it is openly selling a copy.
Q: How do I check whether product photos are stolen?
A: Right-click the photo in Chrome and choose Search with Google Lens, or upload it at google.com. Then compare with buyer photos in the reviews.
Q: Does the AliExpress Choice badge mean the item is genuine?
A: No. Choice means AliExpress manages pricing, shipping and service. It says nothing about brand authenticity.
Q: Can counterfeit items be seized in Pakistan?
A: Yes. Pakistan Customs seizes counterfeit goods, so a fake brand item may never reach you.

## Chinese Size Chart for Pakistani Buyers: Clothes and Shoes
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/chinese-size-chart-for-pakistani-buyers
Category: Products
Updated: October 11, 2026

Chinese clothing sizes are based on your body in centimetres, and a code like 170/88A means height 170 cm and chest 88 cm. Letter sizes from Chinese sellers usually run smaller than UK sizes, so a Chinese L can fit like a UK S. The reliable method is to measure your chest, waist, hips and foot length in cm, then match those numbers to the seller's own cm chart, not the letter. The tables below show how the codes compare with UK, EU and US charts.

Q: What does 170/88A mean on Chinese clothes?
A: It means the garment is cut for a height of 170 cm and a chest of 88 cm, with an A body type, the common middle shape.
Q: Is a Chinese L the same as a UK L?
A: Usually not. A Chinese L is often cut for a 92 cm chest, which sits around UK S on many UK charts.
Q: How do I convert Chinese shoe sizes?
A: Measure your foot length in cm and match it to the seller's chart. Use the tables as a starting point, since brands differ by up to half a size.
Q: Should I size up when ordering clothes from China?
A: If you are between sizes, yes. Also read the reviews, and go up again if buyers say it runs small.
Q: What is 胸围 on a size chart?
A: It means chest or bust measurement. Check whether the chart gives body or garment measurements.
Q: Can I exchange a wrong size from China?
A: Rarely in a practical way. Sending an item back to China from Pakistan usually costs too much, so measure carefully first.

## Pakistan Post vs Courier for Parcels From China
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/pakistan-post-vs-courier-for-parcels-from-china
Category: Shipping
Updated: October 23, 2026

A parcel from China reaches you either by post or by courier. By post, it travels through China Post or a consolidator, Pakistan Customs examines it, and Pakistan Post delivers it and collects any duty manually. By courier, such as DHL or a partner like TCS for UPS, the courier clears customs as a licensed agent, asks for your CNIC and usually lets you pay duty before delivery. Post is cheaper and slower with patchy tracking. Courier is faster, tracked end to end and more expensive.

Q: Who collects customs duty on a postal parcel in Pakistan?
A: Pakistan Customs sets the duty and Pakistan Post collects it on its behalf, through a manual system, never by online link.
Q: Do couriers like DHL clear customs for me?
A: Yes. Couriers clear parcels as licensed agents. DHL asks for your CNIC and says the name on the airway bill must match it.
Q: How do I know if my parcel is coming by post?
A: Postal tracking numbers have 13 characters, two letters, nine digits and a country code. One ending in CN was issued by China Post.
Q: Is there a duty-free limit for parcels in Pakistan?
A: Only one thousand rupees for goods through post or courier, under section 19C of the Customs Act as amended in 2025.
Q: Is a message asking me to pay Pakistan Post customs online real?
A: No. Pakistan Post says it never asks for online payment through links, calls, cash apps or cards.
Q: Which is faster, post or courier?
A: Courier. Air express commonly takes 5 to 10 days, while AliExpress-type post to Pakistan commonly takes 25 to 45 days.

## Importing Electronics From China to Pakistan: The Complete Guide
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/importing-electronics-from-china-to-pakistan-complete-guide
Category: Guide
Updated: October 14, 2026

You can import a single electronic item from China to Pakistan, but check five things before you pay. Phones and other SIM devices need PTA registration. Built-in batteries usually ship fine by air, while power banks and spare batteries often do not. Pakistan runs on 230V 50Hz with C and D sockets. China-market versions may lack Google services or work only on Chinese servers. Warranty is usually limited to the country of purchase, and duty and taxes are charged on the customs value.

Q: Can I import a single phone from China to Pakistan?
A: Yes, but it must be registered with PTA through DIRBS within the grace period or it will be blocked on Pakistani networks. The PTA tax depends on the model, so check the current amount before buying.
Q: Do Chinese chargers work in Pakistan?
A: Most phone and laptop chargers are rated 100-240V and work fine. You may need a plug adapter because China mainly uses type I plugs while Pakistan uses C and D sockets.
Q: Can I ship a power bank from China to Pakistan by air?
A: Usually not easily. IATA classifies power banks as batteries, and standalone lithium-ion batteries cannot go on passenger aircraft without approval, so many couriers refuse them.
Q: Will the warranty work in Pakistan?
A: Usually not. Many brands limit warranty service to the country of purchase, so rely on the seller's promise, the platform's buyer protection and paid local repair.
Q: How much duty is charged on electronics?
A: It depends on the PCT code. Customs duty, additional customs duty, regulatory duty where it applies and 18% sales tax commonly add up to 25% to 60% of the customs value. Confirm the current rate for your item.
Q: How do I know if a gadget is the global version?
A: Check the listing title and specs for Global Version, ask the seller in writing, and after delivery check the software region and whether Google Play is installed.

## Lithium Battery Rules for Shipping From China to Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/lithium-battery-rules-shipping-china-to-pakistan
Category: Shipping
Updated: October 11, 2026

Air rules split lithium batteries into three groups. Batteries installed in a device, like a phone or laptop, ship most easily. Batteries packed in the same box as the device are allowed but, from 2026, must usually be at 30% charge or less. Batteries shipped on their own, which includes every power bank, are the hardest: IATA says they cannot go on passenger aircraft without approval, and many couriers refuse them. For one buyer, that means gadgets are fine and loose batteries are a problem.

Q: Can I ship a power bank from China to Pakistan?
A: By air it is difficult. IATA classifies power banks as standalone batteries, which cannot travel on passenger aircraft without approval, and many couriers refuse them entirely.
Q: Is a phone with a battery allowed on a flight as cargo?
A: Yes. A phone with its battery installed is a battery contained in equipment, the easiest category, and ships routinely as long as the battery is not damaged.
Q: What does UN 3481 mean on a parcel?
A: It means the parcel holds lithium-ion batteries contained in or packed with equipment. UN 3480 means lithium-ion batteries shipped by themselves.
Q: How do I calculate watt-hours?
A: Multiply the nominal voltage by the capacity in amp-hours. For example, 3.7V and 10,000mAh gives 3.7 × 10 = 37Wh.
Q: Why did my camera battery arrive nearly empty?
A: Air rules now require batteries packed with equipment to ship at 30% charge or less in most cases, and recommend low charge for installed batteries too. Charge it fully before testing battery life.
Q: Can I order a replacement laptop battery on its own?
A: It is a standalone battery under the rules, so air shipping is harder. Ask the seller in writing whether they can ship it to Pakistan before you pay.

## How Customs Valuation Rulings Work in Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-customs-valuation-rulings-work-in-pakistan
Category: Customs
Updated: October 11, 2026

A valuation ruling is an official notice from Pakistan's Directorate General of Customs Valuation that fixes the customs value of specific goods, usually per kilogram or per unit and by country of origin. It is issued under Section 25A of the Customs Act, 1969, when normal invoice-based valuation is not reliable. If your item is covered, customs can assess duty on the ruling value even if you paid less. Rulings are published on the FBR website.

Q: What is a valuation ruling in Pakistan customs?
A: It is a notice issued under Section 25A of the Customs Act, 1969 by the Directorate General of Customs Valuation that fixes the customs value of specific goods, usually by origin and per kg or per unit.
Q: Where can I find valuation rulings?
A: On the FBR website, under Customs, on the Customs Valuation Rulings page, which links to a list of ruling PDFs.
Q: If I paid less than the ruling value, which value is used?
A: The ruling value. Rulings act as a floor, so customs can assess duty on the ruling value even if your invoice shows a lower price.
Q: If I paid more than the ruling value, which value is used?
A: Your declared value. Rulings state that where declared values are higher, officers apply the declared value under Section 25(1).
Q: Can I challenge a valuation ruling?
A: A revision petition can be filed under Section 25D within 30 days of the ruling's issue, before the Director General of Customs Valuation in Karachi.
Q: Does every product have a valuation ruling?
A: No. Rulings cover specific goods where normal valuation has caused problems. Items without a ruling are valued under Section 25, starting from the transaction value.

## How to Verify a Chinese Seller Before You Pay
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-verify-a-chinese-seller
Category: Sourcing
Updated: October 11, 2026

Ask the seller for their business licence, then search the 18-character Unified Social Credit Code or exact Chinese company name on China's official registry, the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System at gsxt.gov.cn. The name, code and status must match. Check that the business scope fits the product. On Alibaba, a Verified Supplier badge means an inspection firm such as SGS or TÜV Rheinland checked the company, not that your unit is good. Pay only to an account in the company's name.

Q: What is the official website to check a Chinese company?
A: The National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System at gsxt.gov.cn, run under China's State Administration for Market Regulation. It is free but only in Chinese.
Q: What is a Unified Social Credit Code?
A: It is the 18-character code printed on every Chinese business licence that identifies the company. Search it on the official registry and check the returned name matches the licence.
Q: Does Alibaba Verified Supplier mean the product is good?
A: No. It means a third-party inspection company assessed the company's profile and capabilities. It does not check the specific unit you receive.
Q: Is Gold Supplier on Alibaba a quality guarantee?
A: No. Alibaba describes it as a more basic membership than Verified Supplier. It shows the seller pays for membership, not that their products are checked.
Q: Is it safe to pay a Chinese seller's personal account?
A: It is a red flag. Pay only through the platform or to an account in the verified company's name, and never move a platform order off-platform.
Q: Can I use Qichacha instead of the official registry?
A: Yes, as a convenient source, since it collects registration data from official records. Use the official registry as the final check when you can reach it.

## Gadgets From China That Work Differently in Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/gadgets-that-work-differently-in-pakistan
Category: Products
Updated: October 11, 2026

A gadget made for the Chinese market can behave differently in Pakistan. China-version phones ship without Google Play services. Smart home devices may only pair with an account set to the mainland China server. Plugs differ, US-market items may be 110V only, and radio devices must use frequencies allowed in Pakistan. SIM devices need PTA registration. Before you order, confirm the version, region, plug, voltage and app support in writing with the seller.

Q: Does a China-version phone have Google Play?
A: Usually not. China ROM phones ship without Google Play services because Google is blocked in China. Buy the global version if you rely on Google apps.
Q: Can I install Google Play on a China ROM phone?
A: On some models it is possible through unofficial methods, but it can break after updates and some apps may still not work. It is safer to buy the global version.
Q: How do I know if my Xiaomi phone is a China version?
A: Check the software version in About phone. In HyperOS the fourth and fifth letters of the version code show the region. A missing Play Store is also a strong sign.
Q: Will a Chinese smart home device work in Pakistan?
A: It may, but many China-market devices only pair with an app account set to the mainland China server, which can be slow. Buy the global version where possible.
Q: Are walkie-talkies from China legal in Pakistan?
A: Two-way radios are on PTA's list of equipment needing type approval, and devices must use frequencies allowed in Pakistan. Check the band and the current PTA position before ordering.
Q: Do Chinese appliances work on Pakistani electricity?
A: China uses 220V 50Hz and Pakistan 230V 50Hz, so voltage usually matches. You may need a plug adapter. Avoid US-market items rated only for 110V.

## Warranty and After-Sales When Importing From China
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/warranty-and-after-sales-when-importing-from-china
Category: Guide
Updated: October 11, 2026

Brand warranties are usually limited to the country where the item was sold, so an item bought in China and used in Pakistan typically has no manufacturer warranty here. Xiaomi's Pakistan notice, for example, covers only products sold in Pakistan, and Apple may restrict iPhone service to the country of purchase. What you can rely on is the seller's own promise, platform buyer protection, and paid repair in Pakistan. Keep the listing, invoice and chat, and check the item as soon as it arrives.

Q: Does a phone bought in China have warranty in Pakistan?
A: Usually not. Most brands limit warranty to the country of sale. Xiaomi's Pakistan warranty, for example, covers products sold in Pakistan, with international warranty only for specific models.
Q: Who do I contact if an imported item is faulty?
A: Start with the seller and the platform's buyer protection within the dispute window. After that, local paid repair is usually the realistic option.
Q: Is it worth sending a faulty item back to China?
A: Often not for low-cost items, because international return shipping can cost more than the item. Items with damaged batteries may not be accepted for air shipping at all.
Q: What proof of purchase should I keep?
A: Keep the listing, the seller chat, the order number, invoice, payment receipt, the serial or IMEI, and the delivery date.
Q: Can local service centres repair imported products?
A: Some authorised centres do paid out-of-warranty repairs, but they are not obliged to accept imported units, and parts for China-only models can be scarce.
Q: Do you give a warranty on items you import?
A: No. We are an import service, so any warranty is the one the seller or brand provides. We buy the exact listing you choose and deliver it.

## Pakistan Single Window (PSW) Explained for Importers
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/pakistan-single-window-psw-explained
Category: Customs
Updated: October 11, 2026

Pakistan Single Window (PSW) is the government's online trade portal at psw.gov.pk. Importers, exporters and customs agents use it to file goods declarations, apply for licences and permits from other agencies, link bank payments and pay duties in one place. It runs under the PSW Act 2021, with Pakistan Customs as lead agency. Commercial importers need a PSW subscription, which needs an NTN, NADRA biometric verification and a one-time fee. A person receiving one parcel through a courier or agent does not.

Q: Is PSW the same as WeBOC?
A: No. WeBOC is the customs clearance system built by Pakistan Customs and PRAL. PSW is the wider portal that connects customs, other government agencies and banks, and it is now the main place traders file, with WeBOC sitting behind it.
Q: How much does PSW registration cost?
A: PSW's subscription page states a one-time, non-refundable fee of Rs 500, paid through a PSID. Renewal after two years charges it again, and declaration and agency fees are separate.
Q: Can I register on PSW without an NTN?
A: No. PSW needs an NTN, FTN or STRN. An individual can e-enrol on FBR's IRIS portal, where the CNIC is used as the NTN.
Q: Do I need a PSW account to receive a parcel from China?
A: Usually not. A courier, Pakistan Post or an import agent clears a single parcel under its own registration and asks you only for your CNIC and address.
Q: How long is a PSW subscription valid?
A: The user ID stays valid for two years. Renewal is a fresh process with the subscription fee and NADRA biometric verification again.
Q: Can a customs agent do my PSW registration for me?
A: No. The biometric step must be done by the subscriber in person at a NADRA e-Sahulat centre. A licensed customs agent can file declarations for you under their own registration, but you should not share your login.

AliExpress has a much wider catalogue and official brand stores, but delivery is slower and you usually need an international card. ## Temu Item Not Shipping to Pakistan? Here's What to Do
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/temu-item-not-shipping-to-pakistan-what-to-do
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 23, 2026

If a Temu item will not ship to Pakistan, first check that your app or site is set to Pakistan with prices in rupees, that the link is from temu.com/pk-en, and that your address is a normal physical address outside restricted areas. Then look for the same item from another Temu listing, on AliExpress, or from the Chinese supplier through a single-item import service.

Q: Why does Temu say an item cannot be shipped to my address in Pakistan?

A: Not in a useful way. Each Temu country site delivers inside that country, and forwarding from abroad adds a second shipment, Pakistan customs and the loss of Temu's return route.
Q: Why can't I buy a power bank on Temu in Pakistan?

A: Daraz offers cash on delivery, and many local resellers do too. Temu's Pakistan site did not show cash on delivery when we checked in October 2026.
Q: Is AliExpress cheaper than Temu for Pakistan?
A: It depends on the item. Temu Pakistan has free standard shipping, while AliExpress shipping is set per listing. Compare the delivered total in rupees for the same item.
Q: Is Shein or Temu better for clothes in Pakistan?
A: Shein has the wider fashion range, while Temu has free standard shipping and a free first return within 90 days. Shein returns from Pakistan were self-return at your own cost.
Q: Can I buy from 1688 or Taobao if I live in Pakistan?
A: Not directly, because they need Chinese payment and ship only within China. A buying service orders for you and brings the item to Pakistan, which suits items worth around Rs 10,000 or more.

## Shopping Agent vs Freight Forwarder vs Single-Item Service: Which Do You Need in Pakistan?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/shopping-agent-vs-freight-forwarder-vs-single-item-service-pakistan
Category: Sourcing
Updated: October 17, 2026

It depends on who buys the item. A freight forwarder never buys anything. It ships goods you already paid for from a China address and gets them cleared in Pakistan. A shopping agent buys on Taobao, 1688 or Alibaba for you, then usually bills international shipping separately once the parcel is weighed. A single-item service buys, ships and clears customs for one rupee price agreed before you pay. For one item worth around Rs 10,000 or more, the single-item route is usually simplest. For bulk, use a forwarder.

Q: What is the difference between a shopping agent and a freight forwarder?
A: A shopping agent buys the item from the Chinese seller for you and then ships it. A freight forwarder never buys anything. It only ships goods you have already paid for from its China warehouse to Pakistan.
Q: Do I need a freight forwarder to buy one item from China?
A: Usually not. A forwarder helps when you can pay the seller yourself and have a lot to ship. For one item, a single-item service that buys, ships and clears it for one price is normally simpler.
Q: Why do shopping agents charge me twice?
A: The first payment covers the item, shipping inside China and the agent's commission. The second covers international shipping, which can only be priced once the parcel is weighed at the agent's warehouse.
Q: Can a freight forwarder buy from Taobao or 1688 for me?
A: A pure forwarder does not buy. Taobao and 1688 take Chinese payment methods, so you need a shopping agent or a single-item service that can pay the seller in China.
Q: Which is cheapest for one item from China to Pakistan?
A: Compare the final delivered total, not the first quote. Shipping one item usually costs Rs 5,000 to 20,000, so for items under about Rs 10,000 none of these routes is usually worth it.
Q: Who pays customs duty when I use a forwarder or agent in Pakistan?
A: It depends on the business. Some include customs and some collect it separately after clearance. A single-item service that quotes one price includes Pakistan customs in that price.

Q: Do I still get Trade Assurance if a service buys from Alibaba for me?
A: Trade Assurance belongs to the account that placed the order, so it protects the service. Your protection is the service's own refund terms, so read them before you pay.

## How to Choose a China Buying Service in Pakistan: A Checklist
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-choose-a-china-buying-service-in-pakistan
Category: Sourcing
Updated: October 17, 2026

Choose a service that gives you one total price in rupees before you pay, covering the item, international shipping, Pakistan customs and its fee; states its fee upfront; takes payment to an account in a business name you can check; puts its refund terms in writing; and handles your kind of order, one item or bulk. Ask for an expected delivery date and what happens if it is missed. For a single item worth around Rs 10,000 or more, these checks matter more than the lowest headline rate.

Q: How do I know if a China buying service in Pakistan is trustworthy?
A: Check that it gives one delivered price before you pay, states its fee, takes payment into an account in its own business name and has written refund terms. Ask for its NTN and look it up on FBR's online verification.
Q: What should a China buying service include in its price?
A: The item, shipping inside China, international shipping, Pakistan customs, delivery to your city and its own fee. Anything billed later means the quote is not the final cost.
Q: Is it safe to pay a buying service before my item ships?
A: It is normal practice, as long as you pay a verifiable business account against one agreed total and the refund terms are in writing. Keep the receipt and the conversation.
Q: Why are China buying service quotes so different from each other?
A: They often leave out different things, such as China delivery, customs or a second shipping bill. Convert every quote into the total you will have paid on delivery before comparing.
Q: Should I choose the cheapest China buying service?
A: Only after comparing delivered totals and refund terms. A low first quote that adds customs and shipping later can end up costing more than a higher all-in price.
Q: Is a buying service worth it for a cheap item from China?
A: Usually not. Shipping one item from China commonly costs Rs 5,000 to 20,000, so a service makes sense for items worth around Rs 10,000 or more.

## How to Get an Item That Isn't Sold in Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-get-an-item-not-sold-in-pakistan
Category: Guide
Updated: October 17, 2026

First confirm it really is not sold here by searching the exact model number on Daraz, in local markets and with Instagram or Facebook sellers. If it is not, find the same item on a Chinese site. Temu, AliExpress and Shein deliver to Pakistan for many listings, while Taobao and 1688 do not, so someone in China has to buy and ship it. Check the item is allowed into Pakistan first. For items worth around Rs 10,000 or more, a single-item import service is usually the simplest route.

Q: How can I buy a product that is not available in Pakistan?
A: Find the same item on a Chinese site using its model number or an image search, check it is allowed into Pakistan, then either order it yourself from a site that delivers here, such as Temu or AliExpress, or use an import service that buys and ships it for you.
Q: How do I know if an item is really not sold anywhere in Pakistan?
A: Search the exact model number on Daraz, ask in the local market for that type of product, check Instagram and Facebook sellers, and look for an official Pakistan distributor on the brand's website. If all of these come up empty, it is probably not sold here.
Q: Can I order from Taobao or 1688 if the item is only sold there?
A: Not directly. Taobao and 1688 are built for buyers in China, use Chinese payment methods and do not deliver to Pakistan themselves. You need a buying service or agent that buys it in China and ships it to you.
Q: Is it legal to import a product into Pakistan that local shops don't sell?
A: Usually yes, for personal use. The exceptions are items that need approval or are banned, such as phones without PTA registration, medicines without DRAP approval, drones without permission, counterfeits and weapon lookalikes.
Q: How much extra will it cost to bring one item from China to Pakistan?
A: Shipping one item usually costs Rs 5,000 to 20,000 depending on its size and type, plus customs duty if it is worth more than Rs 1,000, plus any service fee. That is why importing one item usually makes sense only from around Rs 10,000 upwards.
Q: Can someone in Pakistan buy an item from China for me and deliver it to my home?
A: Yes. A single-item import service buys the item in China, ships it by air, clears customs and delivers it to your address. We do this for one item at a time, for one price in rupees that you pay once before it ships.

## How Much Does It Cost to Ship One Item From China to Pakistan?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/cost-to-ship-one-item-from-china-to-pakistan
Category: Guide
Updated: October 17, 2026

Shipping one item from China to Pakistan usually costs Rs 5,000 to 20,000, depending on its size and type. You are charged on whichever is higher, the real weight or the volumetric weight, which is length x width x height in cm divided by 6,000 for air freight, or by 5,000 with some couriers. Batteries, liquids and big boxes push the cost up. Customs duty is separate, except for post or courier parcels worth Rs 1,000 or less, which are duty-free.

Q: How much does it cost to ship one item from China to Pakistan?
A: Usually Rs 5,000 to 20,000, depending on the item's size and type. Small, light items without batteries sit at the lower end, while big boxes and battery items cost more. Customs duty is extra for items worth over Rs 1,000.
Q: How is shipping from China to Pakistan calculated for a small parcel?
A: It is charged on whichever is higher, the actual weight or the volumetric weight. Volumetric weight is length x width x height in centimetres divided by 6,000 for air freight, or by 5,000 with some couriers.
Q: Why is shipping more expensive than the item I bought from China?
A: A lot of the cost is fixed per parcel: handling, export paperwork, customs clearance and local delivery. Couriers also charge in weight steps, so a very light item still pays for the first step in full.
Q: Does shipping cost include customs duty in Pakistan?
A: No, they are separate. Post and courier parcels worth Rs 1,000 or less are duty-free under section 19C. Above that, duty and taxes apply depending on the product, unless your price already includes customs.
Q: Is it cheaper to ship from China to Pakistan by DHL or by air freight?
A: For one item, consolidated air freight is usually cheaper per kilogram than an express courier such as DHL, and it commonly arrives within a few days of courier timing. Couriers can be worth it for small, urgent, high-value items.
Q: How can I find out the shipping weight of a product before I buy it from China?
A: Look for the package size and gross weight in the listing's specifications. Multiply the box dimensions in centimetres, divide by 6,000, and compare with the gross weight. The higher number is what you will be charged on.

## Can I Buy Just One Piece From a Chinese Factory?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/can-i-buy-one-piece-from-a-chinese-factory
Category: Guide
Updated: October 17, 2026

Often yes. Many suppliers on Alibaba sell single units as samples or through Ready to Ship listings, and many 1688 listings start from one or two pieces. Products made to your design, or with your logo, usually need a minimum order. The harder part for a buyer in Pakistan is delivery. 1688 ships only within China and takes Chinese payment methods, and Alibaba courier shipping for one piece is expensive. A single-item service can buy it and ship it for you.

Q: Will a Chinese factory sell me just one item?
A: Often yes, if the item is already made and in stock. Many Alibaba suppliers sell single units through Ready to Ship listings or as samples, and many 1688 listings start at one or two pieces. Custom or logo items usually need a minimum order.
Q: What does MOQ mean on Alibaba and 1688?
A: MOQ means minimum order quantity, the fewest units a supplier will sell in one order. Factories set it because machine setup, materials and packaging cost the same whether the run is small or large.
Q: Can I order a sample from a Chinese factory without placing a bulk order?
A: Yes. Many suppliers sell samples to buyers who want to check quality first. Sample prices vary by seller and shipping for one small parcel is relatively high, so ask for the full price including shipping before you pay.
Q: Is it better to buy one piece from a factory or a trading company?
A: For one piece, a trading company is often easier because it holds stock and is used to small orders. Supplier labels on Alibaba are self-declared, so trade history, reviews and paying through the platform matter more than the label.
Q: Why is the single-piece price so much higher than the bulk price?
A: Because fixed costs such as setup, packing and paperwork are spread over fewer units, and suppliers use tiered pricing where the price per unit falls as quantity rises. For one piece, shipping is also not shared with other units.
Q: Can I buy one piece from a Chinese factory and have it delivered to Pakistan?
A: Yes. Alibaba sellers can ship one piece by courier, though it is expensive. 1688 and Taobao ship only within China, so you need a service in China. We buy single items and deliver them anywhere in Pakistan for one price in rupees.

## Is It Cheaper to Buy From China or in Pakistan? An Honest Answer
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/is-it-cheaper-to-buy-from-china-or-pakistan
Category: Guide
Updated: October 17, 2026

It depends on the item's price and size. For cheap or bulky things, buying in Pakistan is usually cheaper, because shipping one item from China usually costs Rs 5,000 to 20,000 before customs. For items worth around Rs 10,000 or more that carry a big local markup, are hard to find, or come in better versions in China, importing is often cheaper. Compare the full landed price, not the listing price, and count warranty and returns too.

Q: Is it cheaper to buy things from China or from Pakistan?
A: For cheap or bulky items, Pakistan is usually cheaper once you add shipping, which is usually Rs 5,000 to 20,000 for one item. For specialist or higher-value items, roughly Rs 10,000 and up, buying from China is often cheaper, especially when few local sellers stock them.
Q: Why are things so much cheaper on Chinese websites than in Pakistani shops?
A: You are buying closer to the factory. A Pakistani shop has paid for shipping and customs on its stock, plus rent, staff, unsold stock and a margin. The gap is biggest where few local sellers compete.
Q: Is it worth importing a cheap item from China to Pakistan?
A: Usually not. Shipping one item from China usually costs at least around Rs 5,000, so for an item that costs a few thousand rupees the shipping can wipe out the saving. Temu's Pakistan site can be an exception for low-cost items.
Q: How do I calculate whether importing from China will save me money?
A: Add the China price, shipping, customs if the item is worth more than Rs 1,000, and any service fee. Compare that landed price with the best local price for the same model, and give some weight to a local warranty.
Q: Is it cheaper to buy a phone from China or in Pakistan?
A: Often Pakistan, if the local price already includes PTA tax and an official warranty. An imported phone needs PTA registration, and the tax depends on the model, so a cheap China price can end up higher once registered.
Q: Do I lose the warranty if I buy from China instead of Pakistan?
A: Usually you lose easy local warranty service. Claims typically mean dealing with the Chinese seller, and sending an item back to China is rarely practical. That is why a small saving often is not worth it.

## AliExpress Customs Duty in Pakistan: What You Actually Pay
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/aliexpress-customs-duty-in-pakistan
Category: Customs
Updated: October 23, 2026

Parcels worth Rs 1,000 or less pay nothing, because section 19C of the Customs Act exempts post and courier imports up to that value, and the Finance Act 2026 left it unchanged. Above Rs 1,000 the whole value is taxed: customs duty set by the product code, then 18% sales tax, then advance income tax. Pakistan Post or the courier collects it before handing the parcel over.

Q: Is there a duty-free limit for AliExpress parcels in Pakistan?
A: Yes. Under section 19C of the Customs Act, parcels by post or courier worth Rs 1,000 or less pay no duties or taxes. The Finance Act 2026 did not change this limit.
Q: Is the duty-free limit still Rs 5,000?
A: No. The Rs 5,000 limit ended on 1 July 2025, when the Finance Act 2025 set it at Rs 1,000.
Q: If my parcel is worth Rs 3,000, do I pay tax on Rs 2,000 or Rs 3,000?
A: On Rs 3,000. Once a parcel is over the Rs 1,000 limit, the whole customs value is dutiable, not just the part above the limit.
Q: What percentage of the item price will I pay in customs?
A: It depends on the item's PCT code. In our examples, a 0% duty item came to about 24.5% of the customs value and a 20% duty item to about 52%, for an active taxpayer.
Q: How do I pay customs on an AliExpress parcel in Pakistan?
A: For postal parcels, Pakistan Post collects the duty at delivery or at the post office, through its own manual system. For courier parcels, the courier asks you to pay before or at delivery.
Q: Can the seller mark my parcel as a gift to avoid duty?
A: It does not help. Gifts are still assessed on their value, and DHL's Pakistan help page says duties apply whether the item is a purchase, gift or sample.

## AliExpress Delivery Time to Pakistan (2026)
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/aliexpress-delivery-time-to-pakistan
Category: Shipping
Updated: October 23, 2026

When we checked in October 2026, AliExpress listings set to Pakistan showed delivery estimates of roughly 8 to 18 days by AliExpress standard shipping for orders placed that day. Postal routes like China Post commonly take 25 to 45 days, and DHL-type express 7 to 15 days. Customs holds, the Pakistan Post handover and the 11.11 sale are the usual causes of delay.

Q: How many days does AliExpress take to deliver to Pakistan?
A: When we checked in October 2026, listings set to Pakistan showed about 8 to 18 days by AliExpress standard shipping. A July 2026 WorldFirst guide puts most orders at 15 to 45 days once real delays are counted.
Q: Is AliExpress Saver Shipping still available to Pakistan?
A: We did not see it on the listings we opened in October 2026. AliExpress took several low-cost routes to Pakistan offline in July 2025.
Q: Why is my AliExpress tracking not updating in Pakistan?
A: The parcel is usually between handovers, flying to Pakistan or waiting at the office of exchange or customs. Tracking normally resumes once Pakistan Post scans it.
Q: Does AliExpress Choice deliver faster to Pakistan?
A: Not in what we saw. The Choice item we checked showed the same 2 to 10 November window as non-Choice items for an order on 23 October 2026.
Q: What if my AliExpress order does not arrive in time?
A: AliExpress Buyer Protection says you can get a refund if the item does not arrive within the guaranteed delivery window on your order detail page. Open a dispute from the order page.
Q: Do AliExpress parcels get delayed during 11.11?
A: Usually yes. The November sale floods sellers and carriers with orders, so dispatch and transit both slow down. Order early if you have a deadline.

## Is AliExpress Legit and Safe to Use in Pakistan?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/is-aliexpress-safe-in-pakistan
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 23, 2026

Verdict: yes, AliExpress is a legitimate Alibaba Group marketplace and is generally safe to use from Pakistan if you pay only inside the app or website. The real risks are weak sellers, counterfeit branded goods that Customs can seize, slow or lost parcels and duty on arrival. Buyer protection covers non-delivery within the guaranteed window and items not as described, reported within 15 days.

Q: Is AliExpress a real company or a scam?
A: It is a real marketplace that belongs to Alibaba Group. The risk is in individual sellers and listings, not the platform itself.
Q: How many days do I have to open a dispute on AliExpress?
A: AliExpress's Buyer Protection page says items not as described or damaged must be reported within 15 days of receiving them. Non-arrival is covered within the guaranteed delivery window on your order page.
Q: Is it safe to put my debit card on AliExpress from Pakistan?
A: Generally yes on the official app or site. Use a Visa or Mastercard with a modest limit and never enter card details through a link sent by message.
Q: Will Pakistan Customs seize fake branded items from AliExpress?
A: They can. Section 15 of the Customs Act prohibits importing counterfeit products and goods with a counterfeit trade mark.
Q: Does AliExpress refund if my parcel is lost in Pakistan?
A: Yes, if it does not arrive within the guaranteed delivery window shown on your order detail page. Open a dispute from the order page.
Q: Is a message asking me to pay customs online for my AliExpress parcel real?
A: Treat it as a scam. Pakistan Post says it collects duty only through its own manual system and never asks for online payment.

## How to Order From Temu in Pakistan, Step by Step
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-order-from-temu-in-pakistan
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 23, 2026

To order from Temu in Pakistan, install the Temu app or open temu.com/pk-en, check that prices show in Rs, sign up and add items to your cart. Enter a full address with a landmark and a phone number you answer, then pay with JazzCash, Easypaisa or a card, as there is no cash on delivery. Free standard shipping takes 5 to 13 business days after processing.

Q: Can I order from Temu in Pakistan without a credit card?
A: Yes. When we checked in October 2026, Temu's Pakistan checkout showed JazzCash and Easypaisa alongside cards, so a mobile wallet is enough.
Q: Does Temu have cash on delivery in Pakistan?
A: No. Cash on delivery was not among the payment options on Temu's Pakistan site when we checked. You pay upfront by wallet or card.
Q: How long does a Temu order take to reach Pakistan?
A: Temu's Pakistan shipping page lists free standard shipping in 5 to 13 business days, after 1 to 3 days of processing. In calendar terms that is roughly two to three weeks.
Q: Why does the Temu app show dollars instead of rupees?
A: The region is set to another country, often because of a VPN or an old account. Turn off the VPN and choose Pakistan English in the region selector.
Q: How do I return a Temu order from Pakistan?
A: Open Your Orders, tap Return/Refund, choose the items and reason, and pick a refund method. The first return per order is free with CPEX door pickup, within 90 days of purchase.
Q: Do I pay customs duty on a Temu order?
A: Parcels worth Rs 1,000 or less by post or courier are duty-free under section 19C. Above that, duty can apply, and Temu's terms say you pay any amount customs assesses beyond its estimate.
