## 1688 vs Taobao: Which Should Pakistanis Use?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/1688-vs-taobao-for-pakistani-buyers
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 23, 2026

For one item, Taobao is usually the better choice, because its listings sell single pieces at retail and its range of consumer goods is wider. 1688 can be cheaper for the same generic product, but many listings set minimum quantities and price tiers built for businesses. Neither delivers to Pakistan or takes Pakistani payment, so for both you need someone in China to buy for you.

Q: Is 1688 or Taobao better for buying one item?
A: Taobao, in most cases, because every listing is priced per piece. 1688 can be cheaper when a listing has a one-piece minimum, so it is worth comparing both.
Q: Is 1688 cheaper than Taobao?
A: Often, for generic goods, because 1688 prices are wholesale. At a single piece you pay the top price tier, so the gap with Taobao is usually smaller than the listing suggests.
Q: Does 1688 have a minimum order?
A: Many stock listings sell from one or two pieces, but some need more, and factory listings for materials or custom goods have minimums of dozens or hundreds.
Q: Can I use Taobao in English from Pakistan?
A: Not officially. When we checked in October 2026, Taobao's App Store listing named the regions with its English version, and Pakistan was not one of them.
Q: Do 1688 or Taobao ship to Pakistan?
A: No direct delivery that we could confirm. Most 1688 suppliers ship within China only, and Taobao is built for buyers in China, so you need a buyer there.
Q: Can I pay 1688 or Taobao with JazzCash or a Pakistani card?
A: No. Neither accepts Pakistani wallets or cards for normal orders. A buyer in China pays the seller and you pay that service in rupees.

## Yiwu Market for Pakistani Buyers: Can You Buy One Piece?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/yiwu-market-for-pakistani-buyers-one-piece
Category: Sourcing
Updated: October 23, 2026

Usually not. Yiwu International Trade City in Zhejiang, China, is a wholesale market of about 80,000 booths, and most stalls sell by the carton or in lots of a few dozen pieces. A stall may sell one sample to a buyer standing in front of it, but not to someone in Pakistan. For one item, the same kind of product is usually easier to get from 1688, Taobao or Alibaba.

Q: Can I buy one piece from Yiwu market?
A: Usually not. Yiwu stalls are wholesale showrooms that sell by the carton or in lots of a few dozen pieces. A stall may sell a sample to a visitor in person, but not ship one item to Pakistan.
Q: What is the MOQ in Yiwu market?
A: It varies by stall and product. Sourcing agents commonly describe minimums of a few dozen to a few hundred pieces per item, often counted in cartons. Each stall sets its own.
Q: Is yiwugo.com the same as Yiwu market?
A: It is an online directory of Yiwu market shops, linked to physical booths. It is a wholesale tool, and most listings have a minimum of several dozen pieces.
Q: Do Pakistani citizens need a visa to visit Yiwu?
A: Yes. Pakistani ordinary passport holders need a Chinese visa, and when we checked in October 2026 Pakistan was not eligible for China's 240-hour visa-free transit.
Q: Where can I buy Yiwu products one at a time?
A: Search 1688 and Taobao by image for the same item, or check AliExpress. Many of the same goods are listed there by sellers who sell single pieces.
Q: Can you arrange a bulk order from Yiwu for my shop?
A: No. We handle single items for personal or professional use and do not do bulk, wholesale or resale stock. For cartons, use a cargo company and a commercial import route.

## How to Buy From Xianyu (China's Second-Hand App) in Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/how-to-buy-from-xianyu-in-pakistan
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 23, 2026

You cannot buy from Xianyu directly from Pakistan, but you can get an item through someone in China. Xianyu (闲鱼, also called Goofish) is Alibaba's Chinese second-hand app. It is in Chinese, needs Alipay, and sellers almost never ship abroad. A buyer in China pays through the app, the seller posts it to a Chinese address, and it is then sent on to Pakistan by air.

Q: Does Xianyu ship to Pakistan?
A: No. Xianyu sellers post to Chinese addresses, and the app needs Alipay and usually a Chinese phone number. Pakistani buyers get items through someone in China who buys and forwards them.
Q: Is Xianyu the same as Goofish?
A: Yes. Xianyu (闲鱼) is the Chinese name and goofish.com is its website. A separate English Goofish app exists, but buying guides say it focuses on Hong Kong and Macau.
Q: Who owns Xianyu?
A: Alibaba Group. Xianyu became a standalone app in 2014 after starting as a second-hand section of Taobao.
Q: Is Xianyu safe to buy from?
A: Payment inside the app is held by Alipay until the buyer confirms receipt, which protects the buyer. The risk comes from paying outside the app and from used items that are not as described.
Q: Can I pay for Xianyu with a Pakistani card or JazzCash?
A: No. Xianyu needs Alipay. Someone in China pays on your behalf and you pay them in rupees.
Q: Is it worth buying a used phone from Xianyu for Pakistan?
A: Rarely. A used phone needs PTA registration and tax in Pakistan, may be Activation Locked or a Chinese-market version, and has no warranty here.

## Can You Buy From JD.com in Pakistan?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/buying-from-jd-com-in-pakistan
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 23, 2026

Not directly, as far as we could find in October 2026. JD.com is a Chinese shopping site, and its overseas shipping service names destinations such as the US, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand, not Pakistan. Its Joybuy site serves six European countries. JD is still worth knowing: its self-operated listings are a trusted source of genuine electronics, so a buyer in China can order for you and forward the item.

Q: Does JD.com deliver to Pakistan?
A: Not directly, as far as we could find in October 2026. JD's overseas shipping service names countries such as the US, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand, and Pakistan was not among them.
Q: Is Joybuy available in Pakistan?
A: No. Joybuy is JD's European shop. It launched in March 2026 in the UK, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg and delivers from European warehouses.
Q: Is JD.com better than Taobao for electronics?
A: For genuine branded electronics, usually yes. JD's self-operated listings are stock JD buys and sells itself, while Taobao authenticity depends on each seller.
Q: What does 京东自营 mean on JD?
A: It means JD self-operated. JD sells that item directly from its own warehouses and issues the invoice, unlike third-party stores on the same site.
Q: Can I pay JD.com with a Pakistani card?
A: JD added international card binding in July 2026 for eligible foreign visitors shopping in China, but that does not open delivery to Pakistan. In practice someone in China pays and you pay them in rupees.
Q: Will a phone or laptop from JD work in Pakistan?
A: Often, but check the region version and software first. Phones also need PTA registration and tax in Pakistan, and a JD warranty is for China.

## Do SadaPay and NayaPay Cards Work on AliExpress, Temu and Taobao?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/sadapay-nayapay-cards-on-aliexpress-temu-taobao
Category: Payments
Updated: October 23, 2026

Partly. SadaPay's help centre names AliExpress as a site where its Mastercard works, and NayaPay says its Visa card works for international online payments wherever Visa is accepted. When we checked in October 2026, neither company confirmed Temu or Taobao by name, so those are not confirmed. Use the virtual card, switch on international payments and expect a card fee plus advance tax.

Q: Does SadaPay work on AliExpress?
A: Yes, according to SadaPay. Its help centre names AliExpress as a platform where its Mastercard can be used, and recommends the virtual card for online payments.
Q: Does NayaPay work on Temu?
A: Not confirmed. When we checked in October 2026, neither NayaPay nor Temu named the other. Temu showed Visa among accepted cards, and NayaPay says its Visa card works online wherever Visa is accepted.
Q: Can I use a SadaPay or NayaPay card on Taobao?
A: Not confirmed. Taobao takes foreign cards through Alipay, and its sellers usually ship only inside China, so most people in Pakistan buy Taobao items through a buying service instead.
Q: Why is my NayaPay card declined on a foreign website?
A: Check that you are using the Visa card, not the PayPak card, which NayaPay says is not enabled for online payments. Also check that international and online payments are switched on in the app.
Q: How much does SadaPay charge for international payments?
A: SadaPay's help page lists a 6% international transaction fee excluding FED, plus Rs 55 on transactions up to Rs 800. Its own worked example comes to 6.96% once tax on the fee is added.
Q: Is there tax on SadaPay and NayaPay international payments?
A: Yes. Advance tax under section 236Y applies to card payments abroad. FBR's rate card shows 0.5% for active taxpayers and 1% for others from 1 July 2026, though some schedules still printed older rates.

## Tax on International Card Payments in Pakistan: Filer vs Non-Filer
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/tax-on-international-card-payments-pakistan
Category: Payments
Updated: October 23, 2026

From 1 July 2026, advance tax on card payments to merchants outside Pakistan is 0.5% if you are on FBR's Active Taxpayers List and 1% if you are not, under section 236Y. It was 5% and 10% before. Your bank or app also adds its own foreign transaction fee, tax on that fee and an exchange rate margin, which on several cards we checked costs more than the tax.

Q: What is the tax on international card payments in Pakistan in 2026?
A: From 1 July 2026, FBR's rate card shows advance tax under section 236Y of 0.5% for people on the Active Taxpayers List and 1% for others. It was 5% and 10% before.
Q: Does section 236Y apply to AliExpress and Temu purchases?
A: It applies to card transactions with a merchant outside Pakistan, which covers foreign shopping sites. Card providers such as SadaPay treat rupee charges from foreign merchants as international too.
Q: Can I get the advance tax on card payments back?
A: Section 236Y says the tax is adjustable, so if you file an income tax return you can count it against the tax you owe for the year. Keep your statements as a record.
Q: Why is my bank still deducting 5% on foreign card payments?
A: Some schedules had not been updated when we checked in October 2026. Check the actual deduction, and if 5% or 10% was taken after 1 July 2026, ask your bank in writing which rate it applied.
Q: Is FED charged on international card transactions?
A: Tax is charged on the bank's foreign transaction fee, not on the purchase itself. SadaPay's 6% fee comes to 6.96% in its own example, and HBL marks foreign transaction charges as subject to FED or sales tax.
Q: Is there a limit on spending abroad with a Pakistani card?
A: Yes. The State Bank of Pakistan caps card-based international transactions at US$30,000 per person per year, counting all your cards together.

## Can You Pay Cash on Delivery for Orders From China?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/cash-on-delivery-for-orders-from-china-pakistan
Category: Payments
Updated: October 23, 2026

No, not in any way you can rely on. When we checked in October 2026, we found no cash on delivery option for Pakistan on Temu or Shein, and a July 2026 buying guide says it is rarely available on cross-border AliExpress orders. The seller in China has to be paid before it dispatches, so cross-border orders are almost always paid upfront.

Q: Does Temu have cash on delivery in Pakistan?
A: We found none when we checked in October 2026. Temu's Pakistan pages showed cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay, and its terms describe paying with a payment method such as a card.
Q: Can I pay Shein cash on delivery in Pakistan?
A: Not on the payment page we checked. Shein's How to Pay page lists cards and has sections for JazzCash and Easypaisa, but no cash on delivery.
Q: Does AliExpress offer cash on delivery to Pakistan?
A: Rarely. A July 2026 buying guide says cash on delivery is rarely available on cross-border AliExpress orders, and that a Visa or Mastercard is the most reliable way to pay.
Q: Why don't Chinese sites offer cash on delivery?
A: The seller would have to pay for the item, shipping and customs handling before knowing whether you will pay, and returning a refused parcel to China often costs more than the item.
Q: Is paying customs at the door the same as cash on delivery?
A: No. That money is duty and tax assessed by customs on a parcel you already paid for. It is collected before the courier releases the parcel.
Q: Is it safe to pay for a China order before it ships?
A: It is normal for cross-border orders. Pay through the platform's own checkout, or to a service that states the full price upfront and has a written refund policy.

## Do I Need an NTN to Import One Item for Personal Use?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/do-i-need-an-ntn-to-import-one-item-pakistan
Category: Customs
Updated: October 23, 2026

No. To receive one item for personal use by courier or post, you normally need only your CNIC, and the courier or agent files the customs declaration. An NTN is needed when you import commercially in your own name, because a Pakistan Single Window subscription requires an NTN, FTN or STRN. For an individual, the NTN is the CNIC number once you e-enrol on FBR's IRIS portal.

Q: Do I need an NTN to receive a parcel from China?
A: No, not for a personal parcel. The courier or agent clears it using your CNIC. An NTN is needed for commercial imports in your own name.
Q: Is my CNIC my NTN?
A: For individuals, yes once you register. The FBR says the 13-digit CNIC is used as the NTN after you e-enrol on its IRIS portal.
Q: Do I need to register on WeBOC or PSW to import one item?
A: No. The courier or clearing agent files the declaration. A PSW subscription, which needs an NTN, FTN or STRN, is for people filing their own declarations.
Q: What documents does DHL ask for on a personal parcel in Pakistan?
A: DHL's July 2026 guide lists a CNIC copy, the airway bill and a commercial invoice, plus a letter of authorisation if someone else collects it.
Q: Is there a duty-free limit for personal parcels?
A: Under section 19C, as amended in 2025, goods worth Rs 1,000 or less sent by post or courier are not charged duties and taxes, subject to the Board's conditions.
Q: When does an import need an NTN?
A: When it is commercial, meaning goods for trade imported in your own name. Commercial clearance needs an NTN, usually an STRN, and a fuller set of documents.

## Personal Use vs Commercial Import: Where Pakistan Customs Draws the Line
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/personal-use-vs-commercial-import-pakistan
Category: Customs
Updated: October 23, 2026

Pakistan Customs treats goods as commercial when they look imported for trading or profit rather than for personal use or as a gift. That is how the FBR defines commercial quantity, and the definition sets no fixed number. One item, or a few different items for yourself, is personal. Many identical units or goods invoiced to a business look commercial and need commercial clearance under an NTN.

Q: What is a commercial quantity in Pakistan customs?
A: The FBR defines it as a quantity of goods imported prima facie for trading or pecuniary gain and not for personal use or gift. It sets no fixed number of units.
Q: How many items can I import for personal use?
A: There is no fixed number in the definition. One item, or a few different items for yourself or family, reads as personal. Many identical units or a range of sizes looks commercial.
Q: Is a gift from China duty-free in Pakistan?
A: Not as such. The Import Policy Order's gift scheme covers vehicles. A parcel bought from a seller is assessed as an import, and only post or courier goods worth Rs 1,000 or less escape duty.
Q: What counts as a sample under the Import Policy Order?
A: Goods in limited quantity, clearly identified as samples and of no commercial value. A retail item you paid for is not a sample.
Q: What happens if customs treats my parcel as commercial?
A: It needs commercial clearance, usually with an NTN, STRN, commercial invoice and packing list. For passenger baggage, FBR says a fine of 30% of value applies on top of duty.
Q: Can I import one item for my work as personal use?
A: One unit for your own use is not a trading quantity. If a company wants the import in its own name, it clears under its NTN like any business import.

## Can I Import a Drone Into Pakistan? Rules and NOC (2026)
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/can-i-import-a-drone-into-pakistan
Category: Products
Updated: October 23, 2026

Only with permission, and for most hobby buyers the practical answer is no. Pakistan's drone rules require registration with the Civil Aviation Authority, and drone importers have long needed a Ministry of Defence clearance, which individuals rarely get. Punjab also kept renewing a ban on outdoor drone flying through 2026. We do not bring drones into Pakistan without the required permission.

Q: Is it legal to import a drone into Pakistan?
A: Only with permission. The 2024 drone rules require registration with the Civil Aviation Authority, and importers have long needed Ministry of Defence clearance. Without it, expect the drone to be held at customs.
Q: Do I need an NOC to import a DJI or other camera drone?
A: In practice, yes. Drone imports have long required a Ministry of Defence no objection certificate, and the 2024 rules require Ministry of Defence clearance for Category III and IV drones and registration for all.
Q: Does a drone under 250 grams need registration in Pakistan?
A: Yes. As reported, the 2024 rules require every drone to be registered with the CAA, including Category I up to 250 grams. The Remote Pilot Licence starts at Category II.
Q: Can I fly a drone in Lahore or elsewhere in Punjab?
A: Not outdoors without written approval while Punjab's Section 144 order is in force. It was renewed in 30-day steps through 2026, with exemptions for indoor events, agriculture, irrigation and research.
Q: What is the fine for flying an unregistered drone in Pakistan?
A: The reported 2024 rules set fines of up to Rs 100,000, plus up to Rs 10,000 for each day the violation continues.
Q: Can I import drone parts or spare batteries instead?
A: Parts can face the same security screening as drones, and loose drone batteries are hard to ship by air under lithium battery rules. Neither is a reliable workaround.

## Importing Medical or Lab Equipment From China: DRAP Rules for One Unit
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-medical-and-lab-equipment-from-china-drap
Category: Products
Updated: October 23, 2026

Yes, but DRAP rules apply before customs releases it. Under the Medical Devices Rules, 2017, a commercial importer needs a DRAP establishment licence plus enlistment (Class A) or registration (Classes B, C and D) for the device. A single unit can also come in through narrower routes: a personal-use NOC for a patient, a hospital's prior approval, or an evaluation permit.

Q: Does a medical device from China need DRAP approval in Pakistan?
A: Yes. Under the Medical Devices Rules, 2017, customs releases a medical device only after a DRAP clearance certificate. The route depends on whether it is a commercial import, personal use, hospital use or evaluation.
Q: What is the difference between DRAP enlistment and registration?
A: Enlistment is DRAP's approval for low-hazard Class A devices. Registration is required for Classes B, C and D. Both are applied for by a licensed manufacturer or the foreign maker's authorised importer.
Q: Can I import a medical device for my own use without a licence?
A: Yes, in small quantities, with DRAP permission before import if it is not in your own luggage. Apply at a DRAP field office or online with your CNIC, a device list and a prescription where required.
Q: Can a clinic import one machine that is not available in Pakistan?
A: A registered hospital or institution can, with DRAP's prior approval under rule 24(d), if the device is not enlisted, registered or available in Pakistan and will not be sold.
Q: Is laboratory equipment regulated by DRAP?
A: If it is intended for examining human or animal specimens for diagnosis or monitoring, it is an in-vitro diagnostic medical device under the rules. General lab equipment with no medical intended use may fall outside.
Q: Do spare parts and accessories need DRAP approval too?
A: They can. The rules allow an accessory to be classified separately from the main device, so check the accessory's own intended use and class before ordering.

## PTA Tax on Phones Imported From China (2026)
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/pta-tax-on-phones-imported-from-china
Category: Products
Updated: October 23, 2026

A phone imported from China must be registered on PTA's DIRBS system and its tax paid, or it stops working on Pakistani networks after 60 days. The tax is set by FBR, not PTA. It rises in slabs with the dollar value customs uses for your model, and differs between passport and CNIC registration. A phone shipped to you is normally registered on your CNIC.

Q: How much is the PTA tax on a phone from China?
A: It depends on the dollar value band customs uses for your model and on CNIC or passport registration. Check the exact amount on FBR's Mobile Device Duty Information page or the PSID from DIRBS before you buy.
Q: Is PTA tax set by PTA or FBR?
A: By FBR. PTA's DIRBS FAQs say tax and duty imposition is FBR's directive. PTA runs the registration system through which you pay.
Q: How long can I use an imported phone before registering it?
A: 60 days from the day a SIM is first inserted, according to PTA's DIRBS FAQs. After that an unregistered phone loses mobile service.
Q: Can I register a phone shipped from China on my passport?
A: Normally no. The passport route is for travellers who brought the phone with them while travelling to Pakistan. A phone delivered by courier is normally registered on your CNIC.
Q: Did the 2026-27 budget reduce PTA tax?
A: Partly. Regulatory duty on imported smartphones was cut by about 20% in each value band and additional customs duty fell from 6% to 4%, but sales tax was not cut, according to 2026 reports.
Q: How many phones can I register on DIRBS in a year?
A: PTA's FAQs say an individual can register up to five devices in a calendar year.

## Importing E-Bike and EV Parts and Batteries From China to Pakistan
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-e-bike-and-ev-parts-and-batteries-from-china
Category: Products
Updated: October 23, 2026

Most e-bike and EV parts are easy to import from China because they contain no battery. Controllers, displays, throttles, sensors and chargers ship by air like other electronics, and motors are fine but heavy. Loose lithium battery packs are the problem: shipped alone as UN 3480, they cannot go on passenger aircraft without approval, and most e-bike packs are well above 100Wh.

Q: Can I ship an e-bike battery from China to Pakistan by air?
A: Rarely. A battery shipped by itself is UN 3480, which IATA says cannot go on passenger aircraft without approval and must be at 30% charge or less. Most couriers and sellers will not take one by air.
Q: Which e-bike parts are easy to import from China?
A: Parts with no lithium battery: controllers, displays, throttles, brake levers, pedal-assist sensors, wiring and chargers. Motors are allowed but heavy, so shipping costs more.
Q: Can I ship an e-bike charger from China?
A: Yes. A charger is not a battery and ships like other power adapters. Check that its output matches your battery and its input covers Pakistan's 220 to 240V mains.
Q: What is the difference between UN 3480 and UN 3481?
A: UN 3480 is a lithium-ion battery shipped by itself. UN 3481 is a lithium-ion battery contained in or packed with equipment, which is much easier to ship by air.
Q: How do I work out my e-bike battery's watt-hours?
A: Multiply the nominal voltage by the amp-hours. A 48V 14Ah pack is 672Wh, far above the 100Wh line where the fully regulated air rules start.
Q: Will a Chinese EV charging cable work on my car in Pakistan?
A: Only if it matches your car's inlet. China-market cars use GB/T with separate AC and DC ports, and GB/T AC is not interchangeable with Type 2, so check your car before ordering.

## Importing a 3D Printer or Parts From China to Pakistan (Bambu Lab, Creality)
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-3d-printer-and-parts-from-china-pakistan
Category: Products
Updated: October 23, 2026

Yes, you can import a 3D printer or its parts from China to Pakistan as a single item. Hotends, nozzles, build plates and belts are small and cheap to ship. A full printer is a large box, roughly 13 to 44 kg once volumetric weight is counted, so shipping is a big share of the cost. Buy the global, 220 to 240V version, never one marked for mainland China only.

Q: Can I import a 3D printer from China to Pakistan?
A: Yes. One printer for your own use can be imported like other machinery. Check the voltage version, avoid units marked for mainland China only, and budget for shipping on the box size, not the printer weight.
Q: Do Bambu Lab printers work on 220V in Pakistan?
A: The A1 mini and P1S list 100 to 240 VAC. Newer models such as the P2S and H2D are sold in separate voltage versions, so ask the seller for the 220 to 240V unit.
Q: What is the Bambu Lab China region lock?
A: Owners on Bambu's forum report that printers sold for mainland China can only bind to Bambu's China cloud, which limits app use and updates elsewhere. Ask for the global version in writing.
Q: Is it cheaper to import 3D printer parts than a full printer?
A: Much cheaper to ship. An A1 series hotend heating assembly ships in a 40 g pack, while a boxed printer is charged as 13 to 44 kg depending on the model.
Q: Should I import filament from China?
A: Usually not on its own. A 1 kg spool is cheap and heavy, so shipping often costs more than the filament. It can make sense added to a printer order or for a rare material.
Q: Do I need an adapter for a Chinese 3D printer?
A: Usually yes. Chinese plugs are type A or I and Pakistani sockets are C and D, so use a plug adapter or a local power cable rated for the printer's power draw.

## Importing Mechanical Keyboards and Switches From China
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/import-mechanical-keyboards-and-switches-from-china
Category: Products
Updated: October 23, 2026

The best way to get a specific mechanical keyboard in Pakistan, when the model is not sold here, is to import it from the brand's official store or a rated seller in China. Keyboards are light, built-in batteries ship normally by air, and English keycaps are fine for Urdu because Windows includes an Urdu layout. Match the layout, switch type and pin count before you order.

Q: What is the best way to get a mechanical keyboard in Pakistan?
A: If the model you want is not sold here, import it from the brand's official store or a rated seller in China. Keyboards are light and their built-in batteries ship normally by air.
Q: Can wireless keyboards with batteries be shipped from China to Pakistan?
A: Yes. A battery built into the keyboard counts as a battery contained in equipment, which couriers ship routinely. Avoid adding loose spare batteries or power banks to the same parcel.
Q: Do I need a keyboard with Urdu letters printed on it?
A: No. Windows has a built-in Urdu keyboard layout you can switch to with a shortcut, so standard English keycaps work. Stickers help while you learn the layout.
Q: Will Gateron magnetic switches fit my mechanical keyboard?
A: No. Gateron says its magnetic Jade switches are designed for Hall effect keyboards, not mechanical ones. Buy switches that match your board's switch type and pin count.
Q: What is the difference between 3-pin and 5-pin switches?
A: A 5-pin switch has two extra plastic legs for stability. Boards with 5-pin sockets take both types, while 3-pin-only boards need those two legs clipped off.
Q: Should I buy an ANSI or ISO keyboard?
A: ANSI, with the wide single-row Enter key, is the default on most Chinese listings and the easiest to find keycaps for. Choose ISO only if you already type on a UK or European layout.

## Xiaomi China Version vs Global Version: What Pakistani Buyers Should Know
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/xiaomi-china-version-vs-global-version-pakistan
Category: Products
Updated: October 23, 2026

The China version of a Xiaomi product is built for mainland China and the global version for everywhere else. China-version phones ship without Google Play, smart home devices are tied to the mainland China server, and Xiaomi Pakistan's warranty covers only products bought in Pakistan. For use in Pakistan, buy the global version unless you know exactly what you are giving up.

Q: Does a China-version Xiaomi phone have Google Play?
A: No. HyperOS China builds ship without Google services and use Xiaomi's own apps instead. Unofficial ways to add Google services exist but can break after updates.
Q: Can I use a China-version Xiaomi smart device in Pakistan?
A: Often, but only with the Xiaomi Home account region set to Mainland China. Xiaomi says the app region should match where the device was bought, and the Google Play app is dropping China region support.
Q: Does Xiaomi Pakistan give warranty on phones bought in China?
A: No. Xiaomi Pakistan's warranty page says its warranty is valid only in Pakistan and products are not eligible for international warranty, apart from some specific models.
Q: Do I pay PTA tax on a Xiaomi phone imported from China?
A: Yes, if you use it on a Pakistani network. Both China and global versions need DIRBS registration, and the tax depends on the exact model.
Q: Is a China Xiaomi phone with a global ROM the same as a global version?
A: No. Reports in January 2026 said HyperOS 3 checks the hardware region, and converted China phones got stuck in a boot loop. Buy a genuine global model.
Q: Will a China-version Xiaomi charger work in Pakistan?
A: Usually yes on voltage, since most chargers are rated 100 to 240V, but the Chinese type A or I plug needs an adapter for Pakistani C and D sockets.

A: When you want a specific listing that is not in a catalogue, the item is worth around Rs 10,000 or more, and you prefer one fixed delivered price paid once before shipping.

## AliExpress 11.11 and Black Friday 2026: Worth Ordering to Pakistan?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/aliexpress-11-11-sale-pakistan
Category: Platforms
Updated: October 23, 2026

Yes, if the item is not urgent and the discount is real. AliExpress 11.11 is its biggest sale, but delivery to Pakistan already takes weeks and slows further after the sale. Parcels worth more than Rs 1,000 can attract customs duty. Order during 11.11 for things you can wait a month or more for, and order before or after it for anything with a deadline.

Q: When is the AliExpress 11.11 sale in 2026?
A: AliExpress had not announced its 2026 dates on its own pages when we checked on 23 October 2026. In 2025 its Singles' Day sale ran from 11 to 19 November, so expect it to centre on 11 November again.
Q: Is AliExpress cheaper on 11.11?
A: Often, but not always. Note the normal price a few weeks before, because some listings raise the original price to make the discount look bigger.
Q: How long does an 11.11 order take to reach Pakistan?
A: Normal AliExpress delivery to Pakistan is about 15 to 45 days by shipping method, and the post-sale rush usually adds one to three weeks. Plan for December or later.
Q: Will I pay customs on my AliExpress sale order?
A: If the parcel is worth more than Rs 1,000, duty and taxes can apply under section 19C. Couriers or Pakistan Post usually collect them before handing the parcel over.
Q: Can I pay for AliExpress 11.11 with JazzCash or Easypaisa?
A: A July 2026 WorldFirst guide says they are not directly supported at AliExpress checkout. Use a Visa or Mastercard with international online payments turned on.
Q: Is Black Friday or 11.11 better for Pakistani buyers?
A: 11.11 usually has the bigger discounts and earlier delivery. Black Friday orders on 27 November meet the tail of the 11.11 backlog, so they can arrive in late December or January.

## Ordering From China for Eid and Wedding Season: Deadlines
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/ordering-from-china-for-eid-and-wedding-season
Category: Shipping
Updated: October 23, 2026

Order at least five to six weeks before the date you need the item, and earlier around Chinese holidays. For Eid al-Fitr 2027, expected on 9 or 10 March, pay by mid January, because Chinese New Year on 6 February 2027 shuts most sellers. For Eid al-Adha 2027, expected on 16 or 17 May, pay by early April. Both Eid dates depend on moon sighting.

Q: When should I order from China for Eid al-Fitr 2027?
A: Pay by mid January 2027. Eid is expected on 9 or 10 March, but Chinese New Year on 6 February closes most sellers for roughly two to four weeks before Ramadan begins.
Q: When is Eid al-Adha 2027 expected in Pakistan?
A: Around Sunday 16 May or Monday 17 May 2027, depending on the Dhul Hijjah moon sighting. Pay for items from China by early April to be comfortable.
Q: When is Chinese New Year 2027?
A: Saturday, 6 February 2027. Sellers often stop dispatching a week or more before it and restart a week or more after, so plan around late January to late February.
Q: How long before a wedding should I order from China?
A: Five to six weeks before you need it, and earlier for clothes. For a mid December wedding, pay before 11 November to stay ahead of the 11.11 rush.
Q: What if my order arrives after Eid?
A: With us, if it has not arrived within 10 days after the agreed delivery date, you get a full refund. A refund does not replace a missed occasion, so order early.
Q: Are the Eid dates in this guide final?
A: No. They are astronomical projections reported in 2026. Pakistan's Ruet-e-Hilal Committee confirms each Eid after the moon sighting, and the date can move by a day.

## What Is DDP Shipping? Meaning for Pakistani Buyers
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/what-is-ddp-shipping
Category: Glossary
Updated: October 23, 2026

DDP shipping is a delivery term, short for Delivered Duty Paid, where the seller or service delivers the goods to your address with import clearance done and duties and taxes already paid. For a buyer in Pakistan it means the price you agree is the full cost, with nothing to pay the courier on delivery.

Q: What does DDP stand for in shipping?
A: Delivered Duty Paid. It is an Incoterms 2020 rule where the seller delivers to the named place with import clearance done and duties and taxes paid.
Q: Do I pay anything on delivery with DDP?
A: No duty or taxes. Under DDP those are paid by the seller or service before the parcel reaches you, so nothing should be collected at your door.
Q: Is DDP the same as free shipping?
A: No. Free shipping usually means the seller pays the freight only. DDP means the seller also pays Pakistan customs duty and taxes and handles clearance.
Q: Is customs duty still charged on a DDP parcel?
A: Yes, unless the parcel is worth Rs 1,000 or less and arrives by post or courier. DDP changes who pays the duty, not whether it is charged.
Q: What is the difference between DDP and DAP?
A: Both deliver to a named place. Under DAP you clear customs and pay duty and taxes yourself. Under DDP the seller does both.

## What Is Volumetric Weight and How Is It Calculated?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/what-is-volumetric-weight
Category: Glossary
Updated: October 23, 2026

Volumetric weight is the weight a carrier charges for the space a parcel takes up. You multiply length, width and height in centimetres and divide by a set number: 5,000 for DHL, FedEx and UPS express, and commonly 6,000 for air freight. You pay on whichever is higher, the volumetric or the actual weight.

Q: What is the formula for volumetric weight?
A: Length x width x height in centimetres, divided by the carrier's divisor. DHL, FedEx and UPS use 5,000. Air freight commonly uses 6,000.
Q: Why do DHL and air freight give different volumetric weights?
A: They use different divisors. DHL divides by 5,000 and most air freight divides by 6,000, so the same box comes out about 20 percent heavier with DHL.
Q: Do I pay for actual weight or volumetric weight?
A: Whichever is higher. That higher figure is called the chargeable weight, and the shipping price is based on it.
Q: How do I find a product's box size before I buy?
A: Look for package size or packing size and gross weight in the listing's specifications. Use the box measurements, not the product's own size.
Q: Is volumetric weight used for sea freight?
A: Sea freight is priced mainly by cubic metre rather than by volumetric kilograms. For one item, sea freight rarely makes sense because of fixed port and document fees.

## What Is MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) on Alibaba and 1688?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/what-is-moq
Category: Glossary
Updated: October 23, 2026

MOQ is short for minimum order quantity, the smallest number of units a seller will accept in one order. On Alibaba.com it appears as the minimum order on each listing, and on 1688 as 起批量. An MOQ of 1, shown on 1688 as 1件起批, means you can buy a single piece.

Q: What does MOQ 1 mean?
A: The seller will sell a single piece. On 1688 it appears as 1件起批, and on Alibaba.com as a minimum order of 1.
Q: What does 起批量 mean on 1688?
A: It means minimum order quantity. The number next to it is the fewest units you can buy from that listing.
Q: Is the MOQ price the price I pay for one piece?
A: Usually not. The headline price is often for the largest quantity tier. A single piece is normally charged at the top of the price ladder.
Q: Can I ask an Alibaba supplier to lower the MOQ?
A: You can ask. Some sellers will sell one piece of a stock item or a sample at a higher price. Get the agreement in writing before paying.
Q: Does Taobao or AliExpress have an MOQ?
A: Generally no. They are consumer sites, so single pieces are normal, which makes them a good place to look when an Alibaba listing has a high MOQ.

## What Is CIF Value? How Pakistan Customs Values Your Parcel
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/what-is-cif-value-customs-pakistan
Category: Glossary
Updated: October 23, 2026

CIF value is the value Pakistan Customs taxes an import on: the price paid for the goods plus the cost of freight and insurance to Pakistan. Section 25 of the Customs Act starts from the price actually paid and adds transport and insurance. For some goods, a valuation ruling sets a minimum value instead.

Q: What does CIF value mean in Pakistan customs?
A: It is the price paid for the goods plus freight and insurance to Pakistan. Customs duty and taxes are calculated on this value.
Q: Is shipping cost included in the customs value?
A: Yes. Section 25(2) of the Customs Act adds transport to the port or airport of importation, plus insurance, if they are not already in the price.
Q: Is delivery inside Pakistan part of the CIF value?
A: No. Freight after the goods arrive in Pakistan is left out, so the value stops at the border.
Q: Can customs use a higher value than my invoice?
A: Yes. If the invoice cannot be accepted, section 25 allows other methods, and a valuation ruling under section 25A can set a minimum value for some goods.
Q: Do I pay duty on CIF value for a cheap parcel?
A: Not if it arrives by post or courier and is worth Rs 1,000 or less, under section 19C. Above that, duty and taxes are charged on the full customs value.

## What Is the De Minimis Limit for Parcels in Pakistan?
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/what-is-de-minimis-customs-pakistan
Category: Glossary
Updated: October 23, 2026

The de minimis limit is the value below which a parcel enters Pakistan without duties and taxes. Under section 19C of the Customs Act it is Rs 1,000 for goods arriving by post or courier, cut from Rs 5,000 by the Finance Act 2025. When we checked in October 2026, the 2026-27 budget had not changed it.

Q: What is the duty-free limit for parcels in Pakistan?
A: Rs 1,000 for goods arriving by post or courier, under section 19C of the Customs Act. It was Rs 5,000 until the Finance Act 2025.
Q: Did the 2026-27 budget change the de minimis limit?
A: Not that we found. FBR's customs salient features for Budget 2026-27 list no change to section 19C, and the limit stood at Rs 1,000 when we checked in October 2026.
Q: If my parcel is worth Rs 1,500, do I pay duty only on Rs 500?
A: No. The limit is a cut-off, not an allowance. Above Rs 1,000, duty and taxes apply to the full customs value.
Q: Does the de minimis limit apply to mobile phones?
A: No. Phones must be registered with PTA through DIRBS, and the PTA tax depends on the model, whatever the parcel value.
Q: Can I split an order into small parcels to stay under Rs 1,000?
A: It is risky. Customs can treat several parcels from the same sender as one import and assess them together.

## چین سے سامان کیسے منگوائیں؟ مکمل گائیڈ
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/china-se-saman-kaise-mangwayen-urdu
Category: اردو
Updated: October 23, 2026

Q: کیا کوئی عام شخص کمپنی بنائے بغیر چین سے سامان منگوا سکتا ہے؟
A: جی ہاں۔ ایک چیز کورئیر، ڈاک یا کسی سروس کے ذریعے آپ کے CNIC پر آ جاتی ہے۔ اپنے نام پر کاروباری امپورٹ کے لیے NTN، عام طور پر سیلز ٹیکس رجسٹریشن اور PSW اکاؤنٹ چاہیے، کمپنی نہیں۔
Q: کیا چین سے آنے والے سامان پر کوئی ڈیوٹی فری حد ہے؟
A: صرف چھوٹی سی۔ Customs Act کی دفعہ 19C کے تحت ڈاک یا کورئیر سے آنے والی وہ چیز جس کی قیمت 1,000 روپے سے زیادہ نہ ہو، ڈیوٹی اور ٹیکس سے مستثنیٰ ہے۔
Q: چین سے پاکستان سامان آنے میں کتنا وقت لگتا ہے؟
A: ایئر فریٹ سے عام طور پر کسٹم سمیت 7 سے 15 دن لگتے ہیں۔ Temu کی اسٹینڈرڈ شپنگ 5 سے 13 کاروباری دن بتاتی ہے، اور AliExpress کے زیادہ تر آرڈر 15 سے 45 دن میں آتے ہیں۔
Q: کیا ایک چیز منگوانے کے لیے Pakistan Single Window اکاؤنٹ ضروری ہے؟
A: نہیں۔ PSW صرف اپنے نام پر کاروباری امپورٹ کے لیے چاہیے۔ ایک پارسل کو کورئیر یا سروس اپنی رجسٹریشن سے کلیئر کرتی ہے۔
Q: کیا میں چینی سیلر کو JazzCash یا Easypaisa سے پیسے دے سکتا ہوں؟
A: Shein کے ادائیگی کے صفحے پر JazzCash اور Easypaisa موجود ہیں، مگر 1688، Taobao اور AliExpress پر یہ براہ راست نہیں چلتے۔ ان کے لیے آپ کسی مقامی سروس کو والیٹ سے ادائیگی کر سکتے ہیں جو آگے سیلر کو پیسے دے۔
Q: چین سے کم از کم کتنا سامان منگوانا ضروری ہے؟
A: کوئی قانونی کم از کم حد نہیں۔ سیلر اپنی کم از کم مقدار خود طے کرتے ہیں اور کچھ ایک پیس بھی بیچتے ہیں۔ ہماری سروس ایک آرڈر میں ایک چیز منگواتی ہے، بلک نہیں۔

## چین سے آنے والے پارسل پر کسٹم ڈیوٹی کتنی لگتی ہے؟
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/china-se-customs-duty-urdu
Category: اردو
Updated: October 23, 2026

Q: چین سے پاکستان کسٹم ڈیوٹی کتنی ہے؟
A: یہ چیز کے HS کوڈ پر منحصر ہے۔ کسٹم ڈیوٹی عام طور پر 0 سے 20 فیصد ہے، اور ایڈیشنل ڈیوٹی، 18 فیصد سیلز ٹیکس اور ایڈوانس انکم ٹیکس ملا کر کل رقم عموماً کسٹم ویلیو کا 25 سے 60 فیصد بنتی ہے۔
Q: کیا 1,000 روپے سے کم کا پارسل ڈیوٹی فری ہے؟
A: جی ہاں۔ Customs Act کی دفعہ 19C کے تحت ڈاک یا کورئیر سے آنے والی وہ چیز جس کی قیمت 1,000 روپے سے زیادہ نہ ہو، ڈیوٹی اور ٹیکس سے مستثنیٰ ہے۔ پہلے یہ حد 5,000 روپے تھی۔
Q: ریگولیٹری ڈیوٹی اب زیادہ سے زیادہ کتنی ہے؟
A: یکم جولائی 2026 سے SRO 1064(I)/2026 کے تحت زیادہ سے زیادہ ریگولیٹری ڈیوٹی 50 فیصد سے کم کر کے 20 فیصد کر دی گئی۔ یہ صرف فہرست والی چیزوں پر لگتی ہے۔
Q: کیا CPFTA سے چین کی چیزوں پر ڈیوٹی کم ہوتی ہے؟
A: فہرست والی چیزوں پر ہاں، اگر ان کے ساتھ چین کا درست سرٹیفکیٹ آف اوریجن ہو۔ کسٹم ڈیوٹی کم یا ختم ہو سکتی ہے، مگر سیلز ٹیکس اور انکم ٹیکس پھر بھی لگتے ہیں۔
Q: Temu کے آرڈر پر کسٹم ڈیوٹی کون دیتا ہے؟
A: Temu کی Pakistan شرائط کے مطابق جہاں لاگو ہو آپ خود امپورٹر ہیں، اور Temu ایک فریٹ ایجنٹ کے ذریعے آپ کی طرف سے ڈیوٹی ادا کرواتا ہے۔ ڈیوٹی کا بوجھ خریدار پر ہی ہے۔
Q: نان فائلر کو امپورٹ پر کتنا انکم ٹیکس دینا پڑتا ہے؟
A: FBR کے 2026 کے ریٹ کارڈ کے مطابق ایکٹو ٹیکس پیئر لسٹ میں نام نہ ہو تو ایڈوانس انکم ٹیکس دگنا ہو جاتا ہے، مثلاً زیادہ تر چیزوں پر 5.5 کی جگہ 11 فیصد۔

## چین سے ایک چیز منگوانے کا شپنگ خرچ کتنا ہے؟
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/china-se-shipping-cost-urdu
Category: اردو
Updated: October 23, 2026

Q: چین سے پاکستان ایک چیز منگوانے کی شپنگ کتنی ہے؟
A: عام طور پر 5,000 سے 20,000 روپے، چیز کے سائز اور قسم کے حساب سے۔ چھوٹی اور ہلکی چیزیں نیچے رہتی ہیں، جبکہ بڑے ڈبے اور بیٹری والی چیزیں مہنگی پڑتی ہیں۔ 1,000 روپے سے مہنگی چیز پر کسٹم ڈیوٹی الگ ہے۔
Q: چھوٹے پارسل کی شپنگ کا حساب کیسے لگتا ہے؟
A: اصل وزن یا والیومیٹرک وزن میں سے جو زیادہ ہو اس پر۔ والیومیٹرک وزن لمبائی x چوڑائی x اونچائی سینٹی میٹر میں تقسیم 6,000 ہے، اور کچھ کورئیر 5,000 سے تقسیم کرتے ہیں۔
Q: شپنگ چیز کی قیمت سے بھی مہنگی کیوں پڑ جاتی ہے؟
A: کیونکہ ہینڈلنگ، ایکسپورٹ کاغذات، کسٹم کلیئرنس اور مقامی ترسیل کا خرچ ہر پارسل پر طے شدہ ہوتا ہے۔ کورئیر وزن کو مرحلوں میں گنتے ہیں، اس لیے بہت ہلکی چیز بھی پہلے مرحلے کا پورا خرچ دیتی ہے۔
Q: کیا شپنگ میں کسٹم ڈیوٹی شامل ہوتی ہے؟
A: نہیں، یہ الگ ہیں۔ ڈاک یا کورئیر سے آنے والی 1,000 روپے تک کی چیز دفعہ 19C کے تحت ڈیوٹی فری ہے۔ اس سے اوپر چیز کے حساب سے ڈیوٹی اور ٹیکس لگتے ہیں، جب تک قیمت میں کسٹم پہلے سے شامل نہ ہو۔
Q: DHL سستا ہے یا ایئر فریٹ؟
A: ایک چیز کے لیے کنسولیڈیٹڈ ایئر فریٹ عام طور پر DHL جیسے ایکسپریس کورئیر سے فی کلو سستا ہوتا ہے اور چند دن ہی پیچھے پہنچتا ہے۔ کورئیر چھوٹی، فوری اور قیمتی چیزوں کے لیے فائدہ مند ہو سکتا ہے۔
Q: خریدنے سے پہلے چیز کا شپنگ وزن کیسے معلوم کریں؟
A: لسٹنگ کی specifications میں package size اور gross weight دیکھیں۔ ڈبے کی پیمائش سینٹی میٹر میں ضرب دے کر 6,000 سے تقسیم کریں اور gross weight سے موازنہ کریں۔ جو زیادہ ہو اسی پر پیسے لگیں گے۔

## China Se Online Shopping Kaise Karein? (Roman Urdu Guide)
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/china-se-online-shopping-kaise-karein
Category: Roman Urdu
Updated: October 23, 2026

Haan, Pakistan se China ki online shopping ho sakti hai. Temu aur Shein seedha Pakistan deliver karte hain, AliExpress zyada tar cheezen bhejta hai, jabke Taobao aur 1688 sirf China ke andar bhejte hain, is liye unke liye service chahiye. Shein par JazzCash aur Easypaisa hain, AliExpress par international card chahiye. Rs 1,000 se mehngi cheez par customs duty lag sakti hai.

Q: Kya Temu Pakistan deliver karta hai?
A: Haan. October 2026 mein Temu ki Pakistan site par har order par free standard shipping thi aur waqt 5 se 13 business days likha tha, 1 se 3 din processing ke baad.
Q: Kya Shein par JazzCash ya Easypaisa se payment ho sakti hai?
A: Haan. Shein ke How to Pay page par JazzCash aur Easypaisa dono ke hissay hain. Checkout par wallet chunein aur apni wallet app mein payment approve karein.
Q: AliExpress se order aane mein kitna waqt lagta hai?
A: WorldFirst ki July 2026 ki guide ke mutabiq zyada tar orders 15 se 45 din mein Pakistan pohanchte hain, shipping method ke hisaab se.
Q: Kya Taobao ya 1688 seedha Pakistan bhejte hain?
A: Nahi. Dono ke seller sirf China ke andar bhejte hain aur payment Chinese tareeqon se hoti hai, is liye kisi service ya agent ke zariye mangwana parta hai.
Q: China se aane wale parcel par customs kab lagta hai?
A: Section 19C ke mutabiq post ya courier se aane wali Rs 1,000 tak ki cheez duty free hai. Is se upar cheez ke HS code ke hisaab se duty aur tax lag sakte hain.
Q: Kya China ki shopping sites par cash on delivery milta hai?
A: Aam taur par nahi. WorldFirst ki guide ke mutabiq AliExpress ke cross border orders par cash on delivery bohat kam milta hai, aur Temu ki site par humein bhi nazar nahi aaya. Pehle se wallet ya card se payment karein.

## Pakistan Customs Guides for Parcels From China
URL: https://importfromchina.shop/blog/pakistan-customs-guides
Category: Customs
Updated: October 23, 2026

Pakistan customs for a parcel from China comes down to four things: the item's HS code, its customs value, the duty and taxes for that code, and whether it is a personal or commercial import. Parcels worth Rs 1,000 or less by post or courier are not charged under section 19C. These guides cover each step.

Q: Where should I start?
A: Pakistan customs for a parcel from China comes down to four things: the item's HS code, its customs value, the duty and taxes for that code, and whether it is a personal or commercial import.
Q: Are these guides kept up to date?
A: Each guide shows the date it was last updated and lists the official pages it was checked against. Rates and rules change with Pakistan's budgets, so check the date before relying on a number.
Q: Do you handle bulk or wholesale orders?
A: No. We bring single items for personal or professional use. For bulk or stock, use a cargo company or the commercial import route.
